Na GuidelineIT, a gente faz suporte de um jeito raro: com padrão, processo e cabeça de melhoria contínua. Somos uma empresa de serviços gerenciados (MSP) que atende clientes exigentes e ambientes variados, usando ferramentas e disciplina (ITSM, KB, monitoramento e segurança de endpoint) para resolver de verdade e reduzir reincidência, não só “apagar incêndio”. Aqui você vai trabalhar perto de gente boa, aprender rápido com casos reais, e crescer por entrega e evolução técnica, não por politicagem.

Missão

Assumir a rotina de suporte com padrão GuidelineIT: resolver bem, registrar melhor ainda e reduzir reincidência , atendendo usuários exigentes e clientes VIP com processo, clareza e disciplina de SLA.

O que você vai fazer

80% do tempo (operação e suporte técnico)

  • Atender e conduzir chamados ponta a ponta (incidente/requisição) via ferramenta de Service Desk, com registro completo , evidências (prints/logs) e follow-up.
  • Suporte a Windows 10/11 , aplicativos, impressão e periféricos (diagnóstico e correção).
  • Suporte a Microsoft 365 : criação/ajuste de usuários e licenças, Teams, OneDrive/SharePoint (acesso, sincronização, permissões e troubleshooting comum).
  • Rotinas básicas de Windows Server / Active Directory : usuários, grupos, permissões e noções de GPO/NTFS quando aplicável.
  • Suporte técnico a aplicações de negócio (ERPs) como Nasajon, Systak e Alterdata : instalação/atualização do client, configuração básica, validação de acesso e conectividade, troubleshooting de erros comuns e abertura de chamados com evidências junto ao fornecedor quando necessário.
  • Importante: não é suporte funcional (rotinas contábeis/fiscais/folha). O foco é garantir que o sistema rode e o incidente seja conduzido com padrão.
  • Apoiar rotinas de monitoramento e gestão de endpoints via RMM e EDR (ex.: Bitdefender GravityZone ou similar ): triagem de alertas, checagem de status/atualizações, aplicação de ações básicas e escalonamento com evidências quando necessário.
  • Atualizar e criar artigos na Base de Conhecimento (KB) usando template padrão: passos reproduzíveis e específicos por cliente.

20% do tempo (campo e rotina operacional)

  • Atendimentos externos pontuais: onboarding, validação local, troca de equipamento, ajustes simples e apoio em implantação.
  • Manutenção básica de notebooks (diagnóstico e trocas simples) e organização de ativos/equipamentos.
  • Apoio em projetos de implementação e onboarding de clientes (checklists e padronização).

Requisitos (precisa ter)

  • Experiência real com Service Desk/ITSM e disciplina de SLA/follow-up.
  • Boa base em Windows 10/11 e troubleshooting.
  • Noções práticas de Microsoft 365 (Teams/OneDrive/SharePoint no dia a dia).
  • Base de rede (DNS/DHCP/TCP-IP) para diagnóstico e triagem.
  • Comunicação clara com usuário (conduz solução com educação e objetividade).

Diferenciais

  • Ferramentas ITSM (GLPI/Jira/Freshservice/Zendesk/ServiceNow ou similar)
  • Experiência com RMM (monitoramento, inventário, rotinas e automações simples)
  • Experiência com EDR (Bitdefender ou similar): políticas e tratamento de alertas
  • Noções de firewall/pfSense, backup e Linux básico (terminal, arquivos)
  • Certificações Microsoft ou ITIL (se tiver algo acima disso, melhor ainda)
  • Experiência anterior com suporte técnico a ERPs (instalação, logs, evidências, interface com fornecedor)

O que NÃO é

  • Não é vaga de SOC/Analista de Segurança . O foco é operação, triagem, execução básica e escalonamento com padrão.
  • Não é vaga de Azure/Cloud Engineer “faz tudo”.

Benefícios

  • Subsídio para cursos e estudos
  • Bonificação por certificações Microsoft e similares
  • Comissão por indicação de clientes
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico
  • Day off mensal

Como avaliamos (sem enrolação)

  • Teste prático (cenário real): troubleshooting + escrita de ticket completo (diagnóstico, evidência e fechamento)
  • Entrevista técnica

O profissional será responsável por gerenciar, manter e otimizar nossa complexa arquitetura de rede, garantindo alta disponibilidade, segurança e performance dos nossos serviços. O candidato ideal terá experiência prática com firewalls, roteadores, switches, load balancers e tecnologias de virtualização de rede em ambientes de data center de grande porte. Sua atuação será fundamental para a manutenção da infraestrutura de rede, promovendo a estabilidade e segurança dos nossos sistemas, o que impactará diretamente na continuidade dos serviços e na satisfação dos nossos clientes.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

O Técnico de Enfermagem exerce atividades relacionadas aos cuidados de enfermagem de média e pequena complexidade, auxiliando a equipe de saúde na execução dos trabalhos em nível hospitalar, com foco no cumprimento da prescrição de enfermagem.

Realizar procedimentos gerais e específicos de enfermagem, tais como: prestar assistência aos pacientes através de cuidados de higienização, auxílio a alimentação, verificação de glicemia capilar, terapias de suporte respiratório (micro e macro nebulização), aspiração de vias aéreas, manipulação de sondas e drenos, efetuando a limpeza e a desinfecção de materiais utilizados pelos pacientes, preparando corpo pós-morte, prestando assistência contínua aos pacientes em cuidados no fim da vida e sedação controlada, administrando medicamento via oral, endovenoso, intramuscular e subcutâneo, observando horários e posologia conforme a prescrição médica, a fim de obter o equilíbrio clínico dos pacientes;

Coletar materiais para análise laboratorial, identificando-os e encaminhando-os aos laboratórios específicos, a fim de que sejam efetuadas as devidas análises;

Controlar e/ou efetuar desinfecção de materiais utilizados nos procedimentos através de técnicas apropriadas preconizadas pela Comissão de Controle de Infecção Hospitalar – CCIH, registrando e informando dados, a fim de minimizar os riscos de transmissão de infecção;

Participar de treinamento em serviço, a fim de garantir a atualização científica na área, garantindo a qualidade da assistência de enfermagem e a segurança do paciente.

Realizar limpeza de utensílios de banho (comadres, patinhos, balde, jarra, bacias), e de terapia respiratória que serão enviados para reprocessamento, através de técnicas apropriadas preconizadas pela Comissão de Controle de Infecção Hospitalar – CCIH, registrando e informando dados, a fim de minimizar os riscos de transmissão de infecção.

description:
MISSÃO

Diagnosticar, planejar, propor e executar intervenções voltadas para o desenvolvimento de habilidades de linguagem e comunicação em crianças e adolescentes com Transtorno do Espectro Autista (TEA), atuando em equipe interdisciplinar e contribuindo para o desenvolvimento e o bem‑estar dos aprendizes neurodiversos.

ATIVIDADES

Acolhida/Contato Inicial com o Aprendiz, Família, Escola e Equipe Multidisciplinar

  • Realizar acolhimento inicial das famílias e dos clientes, escutando e legitimando queixas e expectativas para alinhamento com a intervenção proposta.
  • Coletar e selecionar informações do histórico do indivíduo e da família, bem como dados de equipes multidisciplinares e escolas.
  • Esclarecer possíveis dúvidas que a família, escola ou equipe interdisciplinar possam ter sobre nosso trabalho.

Avaliação e Desenvolvimento do Plano Terapêutico

  • Estabelecer vínculo com o cliente antes de iniciar o processo de avaliação, a fim de garantir maior fidedignidade nas análises realizadas.
  • Planejar e conduzir avaliações fonoaudiológicas utilizando protocolos específicos da área, bem como participar de avaliações interdisciplinares, sob supervisão técnica, assegurando a integração e a coerência das informações coletadas.
  • Redigir relatórios de avaliação e elaborar planos terapêuticos individualizados junto com a equipe interdisciplinar.
  • Definir carga horária e local de atendimento do cliente, em conjunto com a equipe interdisciplinar.

Intervenção

  • Implementar o plano terapêutico individualizado, realizando a seleção, indicação e aplicação de métodos, técnicas e procedimentos terapêuticos adequados para crianças e adolescentes com TEA, com suporte da supervisão técnica.
  • Aplicar técnicas baseadas em evidências, com ênfase nos métodos voltados para transtornos motores da fala e para comunicação aumentativa e alternativa.
  • Adaptar e modificar as intervenções conforme necessário, com base no progresso do aprendiz.
  • Registrar e monitorar o progresso do aprendiz, mantendo registros organizados e atualizados.

Coordenação, Monitoramento e Trabalho em Equipe

  • Participar ativamente de reuniões e discussões com a equipe interdisciplinar, incluindo terapeutas ABA, coordenadores e supervisores.
  • Respeitar e colaborar com profissionais de outras áreas, reconhecendo a supervisão do caso pelo supervisor ABA.
  • Receber supervisão da fonoaudióloga sênior da clínica, implementando feedbacks para aprimorar a prática clínica.
  • Demonstrar humildade para reconhecer erros e disposição para aprender e crescer profissionalmente.
  • Orientar e fornecer suporte às famílias, cuidadores e, quando apropriado, à equipe escolar.

ESCOLARIDADE/FORMAÇÃO

  • Ensino superior completo em Fonoaudiologia, com registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Fonoaudiologia (CRFa).
  • Formação em intervenção motora da fala (PROMPT, DTTC, REST) e CAA (desejável).
  • Conhecimento em Análise do Comportamento Aplicada (ABA) e TEA.
  • Cursos complementares em Motricidade Orofacial e TEA (diferencial).

EXPERIÊNCIA PROFISSIONAL

  • Experiência anterior de 6 meses na área.

The Manager, Risk Management, Intelligence & C4 (RiC4) is responsible for leading the structured identification, assessment, monitoring and mitigation of safety and security risks for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The role establishes and manages the tournament-wide risk management framework, supports intelligence coordination and contributes to the development and implementation of the C4 (Command, Control, Communications and Computers) governance structure. The position ensures that risk-informed decision-making underpins all safety and security planning and operational activities across official tournament sites.

  • Develop and implement a formal risk and threat identification, assessment and prioritisation process for all official tournament sites and activities
  • Develop, maintain and continuously update the tournament-wide security risk register, ensuring risks are tracked, assessed and mitigated throughout all phases of the event
  • Conduct risk assessment analyses for host cities, stadiums, non-competition sites as well as other specific ancillary events, matches, sites or activities, and develop corresponding risk treatment action plans
  • Coordinate threat, intelligence and situational awareness inputs from domestic and international partners, ensuring structured analysis and dissemination
  • Continuously gather and analyse intelligence relevant to tournament operations and provide structured strategic and operational briefings to senior management and relevant functional areas
  • Support the design, implementation and continuous improvement of the C4 (Command, Control, Communications & Coordination) systems, ensuring alignment with the overall FWWC operational governance framework
  • Enable effective information flow to leadership and operational teams, including leading the daily reporting rhythms and information cycles as defined in the C4i concept
  • Develop standard operating protocols for escalating, responding to and monitoring operational risks
  • Assist in determining appropriate security assets and protective measures required to safeguard official sites and assets
  • Establish and maintain strong working relationships with domestic and, where required, international intelligence agencies and/or with the relevant FA Manager (Public Security) to support integrated security planning
  • Support and encourage the establishment of a Police Cooperation Centre (or equivalent mechanism) to enhance intelligence and information sharing among stakeholders
  • Monitor compliance with statutory, regulatory and organisational instruments relevant to risk management and security operations
  • Support and advise on background check protocols and related risk considerations in coordination with the Accreditation & Access functions

F&B commercial activities will be a shared responsibility with the F&B Manager, Director of Operations, Area Brazil GM and the Commercial Director.

They act as a role model for the commercial community within the owned and managed portfolio, develop teams and individuals in these functions, and serve as a key business partner to the Hotel General Manager, supporting hotels in deriving the most value from Hilton Sales teams. The role seizes opportunities through strong customer relations and works as an ambassador for the company with owners and key stakeholders.

The Commercial Director ensures that commercial management strategies are set for all revenue streams and that all systems are used to their full potential to yield the highest possible revenue from all available space, whether in Rooms, Meeting Space, outlets or other revenue departments. The role drives overall results, gaining an unfair share through disciplined execution of commercial activities.

A Commercial Director will lead, coach, develop, recruit and retain future talents, manage performance, develop and evaluate commercial team members on agreed KPIs, and work as part of a 4D structure on the property.

  • Directly accountable for driving the top-line budget and forecast by implementing a commercial strategy and business plan through to execution using the Hilton Commercial Focus process and all available business tools and intelligence.
  • Deliver at least the budgeted revenues across all revenue streams, including Rooms, GC&E, F&B, Leisure and Spa, with control on cost of sale, route to market, channel shift and marketing/eCommerce opportunities.
  • Work with the GM, Finance and Operations Director to ensure profits are maximized in line with TGOP and EBITDA targets set.
  • Ensure Business Review Guidelines (current to +5 years) and all pricing & rate quotation strategies are in place to maximize all pricing components of sales and catering opportunities and achieve positive group market share.
  • Support various on‑property, RDOS’s, and area marketing teams in coordinating hotel‑level marketing, sales and public relations activities, liaising with regional support and brand teams to maximize performance.
  • Support the Cluster Revenue Managers/On Property Revenue Manager and RMCC to establish an optimal mix, review and validate forecasts, develop strategies for different demand periods, and review and approve retail and group pricing strategies.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with all stakeholders, owners, hotel teams, Hilton matrix support teams to ensure commercial benefits of the hotel.
  • Liaise with VP of Operations, present commercial strategies to Regional Team and key stakeholders.
  • Consistently conform to Hilton brand standards and corporate identity and utilize all communication tools under the guidance of regional marketing and BPS.
  • Keep in touch with market trends and review/amend strategies accordingly in line with evolving market conditions.
  • Participate in the leadership activity of the Hotel and Region.

What are we looking for?

  • Minimum of 3+ years hospitality/travel industry experience in a revenue‑generating or commercial services role.
  • Minimum of 3+ years experience presenting sales plans, presentations, etc. to senior‑level executives and constituent groups.
  • 3+ years experience working in a collaborative/matrix environment.
  • 3+ years working with departmental financial data to make strategic/tactical decisions.
  • 3+ years experience evaluating and identifying business opportunities for a business.
  • At least 3 years of experience managing a sales or commercial team.
  • Fluent in English.

It would be advantageous to demonstrate the following capabilities and distinctions:

  • 3+ years working in a multi‑complex hotel/travel industry environment.
  • Experience in multiple disciplines with knowledge of Marketing, E‑commerce and Finance.
  • Local language, strong attribute to have.

What will it be like to work for Hilton?

Hilton is the leading global hospitality company, spanning the lodging sector from luxurious full‑service hotels and resorts to extended‑stay suites and mid‑priced hotels. For more than a century, Hilton has offered business and leisure travellers the finest in accommodations, service, amenities and value. Hilton is dedicated to continuing its tradition of providing exceptional guest experiences across its global brands. Our vision “to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality” unites us as a team to create remarkable hospitality experiences around the world every day. Department: Government Engagement & Stakeholder Relations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Host City Manager - Brasília will be responsible for the institutional management of FIFA's relationship with the state and municipal governments of the respective Host City of the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027™.

Acting as the main local liaison, this professional will ensure the monitoring and coordination of government commitments under their responsibility, ensuring continuous alignment with FIFA's strategy and guidelines.

The position is preferably based in the Host City itself, ensuring local presence, institutional proximity, and direct monitoring of agendas.

The Manager will report directly to the Head of Government Relations and Host Cities.

The tournament will be staged across 8 stadiums in Brazil, and we’re recruiting the Host City Manager for Brasília.

Please apply only if you currently live in Brasília or can relocate there independently.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. Institutional Relations with State and Municipal Governments
    • Act as FIFA's main institutional representative to the State Government and City Hall of the Host City under your responsibility.
    • Maintain ongoing relationships with state and municipal secretariats, autonomous agencies, public companies, and other relevant local bodies.
    • Ensure that local authorities are aligned with the commitments made in the Host City Agreement and other instruments signed with FIFA.
  2. Monitoring of Government Deliverables
    • Monitor and report on the status of state and municipal government obligations related to the tournament.
    • Identify risks, bottlenecks, and schedule deviations, proposing solutions and making the necessary adjustments.
    • Support, when applicable, the local coordination of thematic working groups (security, transportation, mobility, public services, among others).
  3. Coordination with FIFA's Central Structure
    • Act as a link between the Host City and FIFA's functional areas (Security, Transportation, Operations, Sustainability, Communications, among others).
    • Ensure that local information and demands are reported in a structured and timely manner to the Head of the area.
    • Support the organization of technical visits, workshops, meetings, and official FIFA agendas in the Host City.
  4. Planning, Reporting, and Governance
    • Prepare periodic reports on institutional relations and the status of the Host City's commitments.
    • Update reports, schedules, and monitoring tools defined by the Government Relations area.
    • Ensure institutional consistency, alignment of discourse, and adherence to FIFA guidelines at the local level.
    • Reporting and Governance
    • Coordinated action with other Host City Managers, ensuring standardization and an integrated vision of the project.

YOUR PROFILE

Education
  • Bachelor's degree in International Relations, Law, Public Administration, Communication, Political Science, or related fields.
Experience
  • Solid experience of at least 6 years in government relations, institutional coordination, or public stakeholder management, preferably in complex projects, large-scale events, or institutional environments.
  • Previous experience in large sport events or organizations with an international interface (FIFA, Local Organizing Committees, IOC, etc.).
Behavioral Competencies
  • Organization and method: Ability to structure processes, prioritize demands, and perform tasks efficiently.
  • Proactivity: Anticipation of management and head needs, with a focus on solutions.
  • Attention to detail: Rigorous with quality, consistency of information, and meeting deadlines.
  • Institutional communication: Clear oral and written communication, with tone and language appropriate to the institutional environment.
Differentials
  • Familiarity with management and collaboration tools (SharePoint, Teams, Google Drive, WeTrack, or similar)
Requirements
  • Right to work in Brazil

Department: Safety & Security

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Manager, Risk Management, Intelligence & C4 (RiC4) is responsible for leading the structured identification, assessment, monitoring and mitigation of safety and security risks for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The role establishes and manages the tournament-wide risk management framework, supports intelligence coordination and contributes to the development and implementation of the C4 (Command, Control, Communications and Computers) governance structure. The position ensures that risk-informed decision-making underpins all safety and security planning and operational activities across official tournament sites.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop and implement a formal risk and threat identification, assessment and prioritisation process for all official tournament sites and activities
  • Develop, maintain and continuously update the tournament-wide security risk register, ensuring risks are tracked, assessed and mitigated throughout all phases of the event
  • Conduct risk assessment analyses for host cities, stadiums, non-competition sites as well as other specific ancillary events, matches, sites or activities, and develop corresponding risk treatment action plans
  • Coordinate threat, intelligence and situational awareness inputs from domestic and international partners, ensuring structured analysis and dissemination
  • Continuously gather and analyse intelligence relevant to tournament operations and provide structured strategic and operational briefings to senior management and relevant functional areas
  • Support the design, implementation and continuous improvement of the C4 (Command, Control, Communications & Coordination) systems, ensuring alignment with the overall FWWC operational governance framework
  • Enable effective information flow to leadership and operational teams, including leading the daily reporting rhythms and information cycles as defined in the C4i concept
  • Develop standard operating protocols for escalating, responding to and monitoring operational risks
  • Assist in determining appropriate security assets and protective measures required to safeguard official sites and assets
  • Establish and maintain strong working relationships with domestic and, where required, international intelligence agencies and/or with the relevant FA Manager (Public Security) to support integrated security planning
  • Support and encourage the establishment of a Police Cooperation Centre (or equivalent mechanism) to enhance intelligence and information sharing among stakeholders
  • Monitor compliance with statutory, regulatory and organisational instruments relevant to risk management and security operations
  • Support and advise on background check protocols and related risk considerations in coordination with the Accreditation & Access functions

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • University degree in security management, risk management, criminology, intelligence studies, public safety or a related field

Experience

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in risk management, intelligence coordination or security analysis, preferably within major events, public safety agencies or multi‑agency environments
  • Proven experience in developing and managing risk registers and structured risk assessment frameworks
  • Experience working with law enforcement, intelligence services or governmental security bodies in Brazil
  • Familiarity with command and control structures and operational coordination models

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with the ability to synthesise complex information into actionable insights
  • High attention to detail and structured documentation capability
  • Ability to exercise discretion and handle sensitive information with integrity
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the preparation of strategic briefings
  • Ability to work collaboratively across multiple functional areas and external partners
  • Advanced IT proficiency including MS Office suite, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Word
  • Excellent written and verbal communication in Portuguese

Certifications & Requirements

  • Willingness to travel nationally and work extended hours during tournament periods
  • Fluency in Portuguese (spoken and written) is essential, English desirable
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

You’ll enter our engineering interview process as part of a pooled hiring model. We’re excited to meet people who are energized by complex, ambiguous problems. We look for owners and problem-solvers who are eager to dive into the details of their craft, and are motivated by building products and experiences that meaningfully expand access to ownership.

As you move through our process, we’ll transition from the general pool to a team-matching phase, ensuring that by the final interview, you are aligned with a specific team that matches your strengths and career goals.

  • Risk & Compliance: Scaling the infrastructure that ensures security and transparency across billions of dollars in assets.

The Problems You’ll Solve

As a Senior Software Engineer II, you will lead technically complex projects and serve as a multiplier for your team. You’ll work to:

  • Drive Implementation: Lead the execution of complex technical projects, driving them from concept to production while maintaining high standards for performance and reliability.
  • Simplify Systems: Dig deep into our architecture to identify opportunities to simplify code and infrastructure, prioritizing changes that have a measurable business impact.

  • The Tech Stack: You have experience with (or a desire to learn) our core technologies: Python, Django, React, Postgres, and Kafka. We also utilize Java, gRPC, and AWS.
  • Execution: You can break down complex user stories into actionable tasks and execute them with minimal guidance.
  • Strategic Mindset: You understand the "why" behind your code and can articulate technical trade-offs to stakeholders.
  • Experience: We recommend 8+ years of professional software engineering experience for this level.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Conhecimentos básicos sobre empreendimentos de transmissão de energia (subestações e linhas de transmissão);

  • Conhecimento do Manual de Controle Patrimonial do Setor Elétrico – MCPSE da ANEEL;
  • Conhecimento dos processos corporativos de planejamento e orçamento;
  • Conhecimento prático dos pacotes SAP de gestão de projetos, controle orçamentário, e gestão financeira;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de apoio à gestão, incluindo:
    • MS Project;
    • Power BI;
    • Excel em nível avançado;
    • PowerPoint;
    • SAP FM, PS e FI;
  • Disponibilidade para residir no Rio de Janeiro/RJ , São Paulo/SP ou Brasília/DF.

Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Projetos ou no Setor Elétrico é um forte diferencial;
  • Domínio do Microsoft Project eConhecimento avançado do pacote Office;

title: Senior Software Engineer - MAAS
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

The Canonical MAAS team is responsible for delivering our Metal As A Service hyperscale provisioning technology. Ubuntu strives to be the most scalable, cloud‑ready server distribution and MAAS is our platform to get it there. MAAS is a rapidly evolving software stack written in Python and Go, and we are looking for experienced software engineers who understand performance at scale, networking, storage and usability. Applicants should be passionate about the future of Ubuntu and be able to show technical leadership with a globally distributed team of engineers who share that passion. This position requires international travel several times a year.

This role entails

  • Develop MAAS core components and features to make MAAS the #1 bare metal cloud system.
  • Shape the architecture of MAAS to make it simpler, faster and easier to use.
  • Collaborate with other teams to ensure MAAS works well with other tools and is released on time.
  • Contribute your improvements to our continuous integration environment, tests and practices, to maintain fast feedback and good test coverage.
  • Contribute to documentation of current and existing features, making it a world‑class resource for Data Centre operators and users.
  • Provide technical communication and collaboration with other teams where appropriate.
  • Take personal ownership of problems and drive them to solutions.
  • Travel internationally a few times a year to meet and collaborate with your and other teams.

What we are looking for in you

  • Passionate about open source software, Linux, and Data Centre automation.
  • Solid track record of professional software development experience in Python, Go for back‑end roles, or TypeScript, React for front‑end roles.
  • Capacity to learn quickly about new systems and techniques.
  • Excellent logic, problem‑solving, and troubleshooting skills.
  • Strong English language communication skills – both written and verbal.
  • Experience with Linux server technologies, including but not limited to Virtualization (KVM), Containers (LXC), etc.
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree.
  • Knowledge of network technologies, including PXE, DHCP, TFTP, DNS, NTP.
  • Some experience with Baseboard Management Controllers and Protocols (Redfish, IPMI, AMT and others).
  • Strong experience with networking, storage technologies and Cloud hosting and infrastructure.
  • Ideally, experience of large‑scale physical server provisioning and automation, including rapid deployment, configuration, management and service orchestration.
  • Familiarity with some of the open source development tools and methodologies used in creation of several Ubuntu projects (MAAS, Juju, Ubuntu Server, LXD, Ubuntu Core), such as Launchpad, Debian packaging tools (APT, dpkg) and snapcraft.
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and preferably university.
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events.

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person.
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.
  • Annual compensation review.
  • Recognition rewards.
  • Annual holiday leave.
  • Maternity and paternity leave.
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events.

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Host City Manager – Brasília
description:
Department: Government Engagement & Stakeholder Relations

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Host City Manager – Brasília will be responsible for the institutional management of FIFA's relationship with the state and municipal governments of the respective Host City of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Acting as the main local liaison, this professional will ensure the monitoring and coordination of government commitments under their responsibility, ensuring continuous alignment with FIFA's strategy and guidelines. The position is preferably based in the Host City itself, ensuring local presence, institutional proximity, and direct monitoring of agendas. The Manager will report directly to the Head of Government Relations and Host Cities. The tournament will be staged across 8 stadiums in Brazil, and we’re recruiting the Host City Manager for Brasília. Please apply only if you currently live in Brasília or can relocate there independently.

Key Responsibilities

1. Institutional Relations with State and Municipal Governments

  • Act as FIFA's main institutional representative to the State Government and City Hall of the Host City under your responsibility.
  • Maintain ongoing relationships with state and municipal secretariats, autonomous agencies, public companies, and other relevant local bodies.
  • Ensure that local authorities are aligned with the commitments made in the Host City Agreement and other instruments signed with FIFA.

2. Monitoring of Government Deliverables

  • Monitor and report on the status of state and municipal government obligations related to the tournament.
  • Identify risks, bottlenecks, and schedule deviations, proposing solutions and making the necessary adjustments.
  • Support, when applicable, the local coordination of thematic working groups (security, transportation, mobility, public services, among others).

3. Coordination with FIFA's Central Structure

  • Act as a link between the Host City and FIFA's functional areas (Security, Transportation, Operations, Sustainability, Communications, among others).
  • Ensure that local information and demands are reported in a structured and timely manner to the Head of the area.
  • Support the organization of technical visits, workshops, meetings, and official FIFA agendas in the Host City.

4. Planning, Reporting, and Governance

  • Prepare periodic reports on institutional relations and the status of the Host City's commitments.
  • Update reports, schedules, and monitoring tools defined by the Government Relations area.
  • Ensure institutional consistency, alignment of discourse, and adherence to FIFA guidelines at the local level.
  • Reporting and Governance
  • Coordinated action with other Host City Managers, ensuring standardization and an integrated vision of the project.

Your Profile

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in International Relations, Law, Public Administration, Communication, Political Science, or related fields.

Experience

  • Solid experience of at least 6 years in government relations, institutional coordination, or public stakeholder management, preferably in complex projects, large-scale events, or institutional environments.

The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world‑class software, purpose‑built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that – it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets – a connected ERP for private capital.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Team You’ll Work With

You’ll enter our engineering interview process as part of a pooled hiring model. We believe in hiring for Carta first, focusing on your core strengths and technical craft rather than a specific team’s immediate gap.

Staff Engineers at Carta are technical anchors for our business. You don’t just own features, you take long‑term accountability for the technical health and strategic direction of different domains. As you move through our process, we’ll transition from the general pool to a team‑matching phase. Our goal is to match your unique technical strengths, and personal career interests with our most impactful, strategic challenges.

Strategic areas you may influence

  • Platform Data Ecosystem: Shaping how data flows across our entire suite of products to ensure a "single source of truth" for private market data.
  • Financial Systems Architecture: Designing resilient, scalable solutions for management fee accounting and multi‑currency transactions.
  • Engineering Excellence: Defining company‑wide standards that reduce operational load and improve developer velocity across dozens of teams.

The Problems You’ll Solve

As a Staff Engineer, you are responsible for the long‑term technical health and success of your business unit. You’ll work to:

  • Navigate Ambiguity: Tackle the most complex and poorly defined problems at Carta, breaking them down into navigable paths for the rest of the organization.
  • Champion Systemic Improvement: Identify and eliminate failure patterns across multiple systems, driving architectural changes that improve scalability and reliability.

You’ll help move the organization toward a future where AI amplifies our collective engineering impact.

About You

Job Purpose

The Senior People Operations Officer serves as the College’s principal operational administrator for all HR-, payroll-, and hiring-related transactions. This role ensures the accuracy, compliance, and timely processing of personnel actions for faculty, staff, adjuncts, student employees, wage workers, and stipend-supported personnel. The incumbent functions as the College’s primary point of coordination between CEA leadership, HR, Payroll, the Office of the Provost, and departmental administrators. This is not an HR strategic role; instead, it is a senior-level operational and transactional position responsible for end‑to‑end workflow execution, Workday processing, onboarding, offboarding, and compliance.

Supervisory Authority

Responsible for supervising the Budget Coordinator, Administrative III. Formally plans, assigns, directs, and evaluates work performed. Makes merit and promotion recommendations to the Dean and ensures professional development alignment with institutional expectations.

Nature And Scope

The Senior People Operations Officer interacts daily with academic departments, program directors, faculty, HR Business Partners, the Budget Office, Payroll, and the Office of the Provost. The incumbent must exercise a high degree of accuracy and judgment in handling sensitive personnel information, navigating complex approval processes, and ensuring compliance with University policy, hiring standards, and audit expectations.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Serve as the College’s senior Workday transaction specialist for all hires, job changes, faculty terminations, PAPs, compensation changes, funding changes, and academic appointments.
  • Coordinate all job posting requests with HR Recruiting and ensure funding alignment prior to submission.
  • Draft and monitor term sheets, offer letters (where applicable), hiring packets, and background check requirements.
  • Manage onboarding workflows including I‑9, tax documentation, direct deposit, employee access, and new employee orientation tracking.
  • Initiate and track offboarding workflows for employees, adjunct faculty, and student workers.

  • Maintain weekly hiring and transaction status reports for CEA leadership.

  • Provide training and guidance to department administrators, chairs, and coordinators on Workday processes and personnel workflows.
  • Maintain and update standard operating procedures (SOPs) for hiring, onboarding, terminations, PAPs, and Workday routing.
  • Liaise with HR, Payroll, and the Office of the Provost to resolve transactional issues and ensure timely processing.
  • Serve as subject‑matter expert for Workday HR and Workday Finance functionality relevant to personnel transactions.
  • Provide people‑data inputs to the Assistant Dean for reporting and planning (not financial analysis).
  • Manage confidential personnel information in accordance with University policies.

Core Competencies

  • Demonstrated ability to provide executive-level financial and operational guidance in a complex academic environment.
  • Deep knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, accounting controls, and resource stewardship.
  • Ability to interpret policy, influence adoption, and lead change with diplomacy and clarity in evolving systems.
  • Ability to supervise, develop, mentor, and evaluate staff performance and ensure accountability.

About Maximus

Maximus ( is a mission‑driven consumer performance medicine telehealth company that provides men and women with content, community, and clinical support to optimize their health, wellness, and hormones. Maximus has achieved profitability, 8‑figure ARR, and is doubling year over year – with a strong cash position. We have raised $15M from top Silicon Valley VCs such as Founders Fund and 8VC as well as leading angel investors/operators from companies like Bulletproof, Tinder, Coinbase, Daily Stoic, & Shopify.

We also offer Maximus Labs, a standalone biomarker testing subscription that doubles as an acquisition channel into our telemedicine protocols. We’re targeting 2x customer growth this year and need a Growth Lead who can build the acquisition engine that gets us there.

We’re capital‑efficient and compete against Hims, Hone, Keeps, and Fella by being better at the product, not louder with ad spend. Our growth strategy is conversion‑driven: make the signup‑to‑checkout funnel so good that paid channels become more efficient by default.

About The Role

We are looking for a strong Lead Engineer (Tech Lead) to lead our Growth engineering team. You will be splitting your time roughly 50/50 between management and coding. You own the lower acquisition funnel, from flow start through checkout, across all Maximus protocols.

Your north star metric is Flow Start to Checkout CVR. You also carry an M1 Retention guardrail, which means you can’t optimize for conversion at the expense of user quality. Every experiment you ship has a built‑in quality check.

You will manage a small team of engineers and work directly with a Sr. PM and Sr. Designer. You will report directly to the Head of Engineering.

Why this role?

  • Impact: Set the technical direction for how Maximus acquires customers, run experiments that directly move revenue, and build a team that compounds learning over time. The Growth team’s output is visible in the company's top‑line numbers every month.
  • First 90 days: Complete BNPL migration to Klarna across all protocols.
  • First 2 quarters: Launch a new activation satisfaction survey for our retention guardrail and build cohort‑level experiment tracking.
  • Maximus is at the stage where the acquisition engine needs a dedicated engineering leader who stays with the problem long enough to compound results. If you want to own that end to end, with real authority and real accountability, this is the role for you.

What You Will Do (Key Responsibilities)

  • Deliver protocol‑level A/B experiments on signup flows, checkout, plan pricing, and product recommendations using Amplitude.
  • Ship full‑stack features across the acquisition funnel in Rails and React.
  • Coach and develop your engineering team through regular 1:1s, pair programming, code reviews, and career conversations.
  • Own experiment design, including sample sizing, metric selection, and the CVR‑vs‑retention tension that comes with a dual mandate.
  • Iterate and continuously optimize plan and pricing architecture, including payment platform integrations.
  • Build and maintain the experimentation infrastructure your team runs on.
  • Partner with data engineering to instrument cohort‑level M1 retention tracking per experiment.
  • Drive adoption of AI‑assisted development across the team, using tools like Claude Code and Devin to increase shipping and development velocity.

Our Tech Stack

  • Ruby on Rails 7 / Ruby 3.3, React 18 / TypeScript 5.4 (required)
  • Event‑sourced architecture with command pattern
  • PostgreSQL, Redis, Delayed Job for background processing
  • Stripe and Klarna for payments and installment plans
  • Amplitude for experimentation and analytics, Segment for event collection
  • Redux with redux-loop and Immutable.js on the frontend
  • Docker, AWS/GCP, Aptible, GitHub Actions CI/CD
  • Cypress for E2E testing

title: Sr. Product Manager, Growth (NGL) (Remote)
description:
Who We Are

Mode Mobile builds apps that reward users for engaging with content, entertainment, games, and communities they love. Our portfolio includes category-defining products with millions of users globally, scaling rapidly through organic growth and strategic acquisitions.

You will be joining NGL ("Not Gonna Lie") , one of the most viral social apps in recent years, with 144M+ monthly users across web and mobile. NGL provides a safe, curious, and authentic space for people to connect through anonymous messaging and self-expression.

Now part of Mode Mobile's portfolio, NGL is entering its next phase of explosive growth, including expanded monetization, creative experimentation, and scaled user acquisition initiatives.

The Mission

Own and scale NGL's revenue, funnels, and lifecycle growth by turning traffic into durable, monetizable user behavior. You will run growth as a system…from acquisition through retention…while protecting the viral mechanics that make NGL work.

This role is measured in metrics shipped , not features shipped.

Our Team and Culture Drive Our Success

Our team is the heart of our culture. We value innovation, collaboration, and curiosity, with a passion for getting things done. We strive to hire and cultivate the best team members and foster a culture of open communication and transparency. We are driven and hard‑working but also committed to having fun along the way. We allow OKRs to guide us, assume positive intent, sometimes agree to disagree and commit, honor our commitments, seek to accomplish more with less, and encourage everyone to speak up as our team owns our company's success.

You can read more about our team and how we work here.

The Role

This role reports directly to the General Manager – NGL and operates as the single‑threaded owner of growth and monetization for the product. You will work cross‑functionally with Monetization, Paid UA, Engineering, Design, and Data , and you will own feature rollout end‑to‑end in partnership with Engineering.

What You’ll Do

  • Monetization Systems
    • You own all product‑led revenue systems:
      • Subscription pricing, tiers, and trials
      • Optimize onboarding and paywall timing by traffic source
      • One‑time purchases (reveals, hints, boosts)
      • Paywall timing, copy, UX, and placement
      • Revenue per active user (ARPDAU / ARPU)
      • Monetization performance by cohort (influencer, paid UA, organic)
      • Extensive collaboration with Monetization Team by translating revenue strategy into shipped product features
    • You are accountable for revenue lift without growth decay.
  • Organic Funnels, Influencer & Creator Funnels
    • NGL is creator‑driven. You own:
      • Influencer onboarding flows
      • Creator‑specific product surfaces and incentives
      • Conversion paths from influencer posts → installs → paid actions
      • Monetization differences by creator tier and audience quality
      • Feedback loops that increase creator posting frequency and retention
    • Partnerships source creators. Product owns the funnel.
  • Funnel Ownership (End‑to‑End)
    • You own the full lifecycle:
      • Entry (Snap, IG, TikTok, deep links)
      • First‑session experience and activation
      • Message reveal mechanics and engagement triggers
      • Re‑engagement loops (notifications, prompts, scarcity)
      • Conversion to paid
      • Design funnels that improve LTV and payback
      • Retention, churn reduction, and win‑back flows
    • You are expected to know where every drop‑off lives.
  • Experimentation & Growth Velocity
    • You will:
      • Maintain a prioritized growth experiment backlog
      • Run continuous A/B tests across onboarding, pricing, and UX
      • Test influencer‑specific monetization strategies
      • Kill underperforming ideas quickly
      • Scale winners aggressively
      • K‑Factor Optimization
    • Speed and learning rate matter more than perfection.
  • Feature Ownership & Rollout (Engineering)
    • You own feature execution end‑to‑end:
      • Write clear PRDs tied to growth and revenue outcomes
      • Prioritize engineering work based on expected impact
      • Partner with engineering to ship experiments quickly
      • Own rollout plans, gating, and ramp strategies
      • Monitor post‑launch performance and iterate fast
    • You ship, measure, and refine. No throw‑it‑over‑the‑wall handoffs.
  • Reporting, Dashboards & GM Updates
    • You will:
      • Build and maintain clear growth dashboards
      • Report weekly to the NGL GM on:
        • Revenue performance
        • Funnel metrics
        • Experiment results
        • Key risks and opportunities
        • Provide data‑backed recommendations for roadmap and spend decisions
      • The GM should never be surprised by the numbers

Success in This Role Means

  • You are directly accountable for:
    • Paid conversion rate
    • ARPU / LTV
    • D7 / D30 retention
    • Revenue by acquisition source
    • LTV / CAC and payback period
    • Experiment velocity

What You Bring to the Team

  • 5–8+ years of experience in Growth Product, Monetization, or Lifecycle Product roles within consumer mobile apps, with clear ownership of revenue and growth outcomes
  • Direct ownership of core metrics such as ARPDAU, ARPU, LTV, conversion rate, retention, and payback
  • Experience scaling subscription and hybrid monetization models, including subscriptions and one‑time purchases
  • Experience owning pricing strategy, paywalls, onboarding optimization, and revenue performance by cohort
  • Strong data fluency, including cohort analysis, funnel diagnostics, and payback modeling
  • Proven track record running high‑velocity A/B testing and maintaining a structured experimentation backlog
  • Demonstrated success improving acquisition, activation, monetization, and retention through measurable experimentation
  • Experience partnering closely with Engineering to ship growth and monetization features end‑to‑end
  • Experience working cross‑functionally with UA, Monetization, Design, and Data teams
  • Comfort operating as the accountable owner of revenue impact
  • A systems mindset that prioritizes measurable outcomes over feature output
  • Ability to move quickly, make decisions with imperfect information, and balance aggressive growth optimization with protecting product integrity and viral mechanics
  • Experience in creator‑driven or social products preferred
  • Experience optimizing K‑Factor and viral loops preferred
  • Experience working with Snap, Instagram, or TikTok acquisition funnels preferred
  • Alignment with our core values:
    • Accountable: You take ownership of your responsibilities, demonstrating trustworthiness and self‑discipline. You are consistent in your work, transparent in your actions, and communicate effectively. You follow through on commitments and strive for continuous improvement.
    • Action‑driven: Identify what is most important, agree on scope, execute in a timely manner, and drive the greatest impact. You take initiative, roll up your sleeves, and get things done.
    • Caring: You genuinely care about yourself and others, our business and craft, our mission and vision, and are passionate in heart and mind. You understand the importance of our team and strive to create a positive, supportive work environment.
    • Curious: You focus on the 'why,' learn and expand your knowledge, explore new ideas, and generally make things better. You're a lifelong learner with a thirst for knowledge and a constant desire to improve.
    • Thorough: Your work is thoughtful, impactful, timely, accurate, and complete. You pay attention to detail, are meticulous, and ensure quality work and compliance.

Why Join Mode Mobile

  • Be part of a company where the culture is the magic . Our team consistently says the best part of Mode is the people – collaborative, humble, hungry, and genuinely invested in each other's success.
  • Make an impact on millions of users across a global social platform with massive scale and cultural relevance.
  • Work with a global, top‑tier engineering team that cares deeply about craftsmanship, velocity, and helping each other win.
  • Shape the next stage of a high‑growth social platform , entering an exciting next phase of growth, scale, and innovation.
  • Join a mission‑driven culture where ownership is real, ideas travel fast, and your work has a visible impact.
  • Grow inside a fast‑growing, post‑acquisition business backed by strong leadership and investment in monetization, UA, and product innovation.
  • Work fully remote with a globally distributed team that values autonomy, trust, and transparent collaboration.

We Believe in the Following Workplace Norms

  • Allow OKRs to Guide Us
  • Assume Positive Intent
  • Agree to Disagree & Commit
  • Set New Precedents
  • Accomplish More with Less
  • Hold Yourself & Others to High Standards
  • Speak Up
  • Be Resourceful
  • Follow the 80/20 Rule

What We Are Offering

  • We are a 100% remote‑first, global company.
  • A competitive compensation package.
  • We offer generous perks & benefits to team members.
  • Participation in the Company's equity plan (for full‑time team members).
  • We provide individual bonuses in accordance with our Company Bonus Program.
  • Work with energetic, passionate, and results‑driven people.
  • Celebrate team members' personal and work milestones.
  • Remote social activities, including virtual coffee buddies.
  • Bonusly – We use Bonusly as a way to recognize and reward team members for their hard work and commitment.
  • Weekly Wednesday Get Stuff Done Days (No Meetings).
  • Open PTO, generous Company Holidays, and Wellness Days (for full‑time team members).

title: OPERADOR(A) LOGISTICA I
description:
Com 124 anos de história, a Gerdau é a maior empresa brasileira produtora de aço e uma das principais fornecedoras de aços longos nas Américas e de aços especiais no mundo. No Brasil, também produz aços planos, além de minério de ferro para consumo próprio. Além disso, possui uma divisão de novos negócios, a Gerdau Next, com o objetivo de empreender em segmentos adjacentes ao aço. Com o propósito de empoderar pessoas que constroem o futuro, a companhia está presente em vários países e conta com mais de 30 mil colaboradores em todas as suas operações. Maior recicladora da América Latina, a Gerdau tem na sucata uma importante matéria-prima: mais de 70% do aço que produz é feito a partir desse material. Todo ano, 11 milhões de toneladas de sucata são transformadas em diversos produtos de aço. A companhia também é a maior produtora de carvão vegetal do mundo, com mais de 250 mil hectares de base florestal no estado de Minas Gerais. Como resultado de sua matriz produtiva sustentável, a Gerdau possui, atualmente, uma das menores médias de emissão de gases de efeito estufa (CO₂e), de 0,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço, o que representa aproximadamente a metade da média global do setor, de 1,91 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço (worldsteel). Para 2031, a meta da Gerdau é diminuir as emissões de carbono para 0,82 t de CO₂e por tonelada de aço. As ações da Gerdau estão listadas nas bolsas de valores de São Paulo (B3) e Nova Iorque (NYSE).

Estamos em busca de um Operador de Logística altamente motivado e dedicado para se juntar à nossa equipe dinâmica. O candidato ideal será responsável por executar diversas tarefas relacionadas à logística, incluindo recebimento, armazenamento, preparação e expedição de produtos. Buscamos alguém com habilidades organizacionais excepcionais, capacidade de trabalho em equipe e atenção aos detalhes para garantir a eficiência e a precisão de nossas operações logísticas.

Responsabilidades

  • Receber, conferir e registrar produtos conforme os procedimentos estabelecidos.
  • Armazenar e organizar produtos em locais designados, garantindo o uso eficiente do espaço e a preservação da integridade dos itens.
  • Preparar pedidos de acordo com as especificações do cliente, utilizando equipamentos de movimentação de carga, como empilhadeiras ou paleteiras.
  • Realizar a expedição de produtos, preparando documentação necessária, como notas fiscais e ordens de entrega.
  • Monitorar e controlar os níveis de estoque, realizando inventários periódicos e identificando possíveis discrepâncias.
  • Colaborar com outros membros da equipe para garantir a eficiência das operações logísticas e o cumprimento dos prazos de entrega.
  • Seguir rigorosamente os procedimentos de segurança e higiene no trabalho, garantindo um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todos os colaboradores.
  • Manter a área de trabalho limpa, organizada e livre de obstruções, conforme os padrões de segurança e qualidade.

OBS: Carteira de habilitação é necessário

Temos como princípio a promoção de um ambiente diverso e inclusivo. Respeitamos e valorizamos a diversidade, por isso todas as pessoas qualificadas serão consideradas para as vagas sem distinção de deficiência, gênero, idade, identidade ou orientação sexual, nacionalidade, raça, religião, ou qualquer outra característica.

Descrição da vaga

Sobre a vaga

NaM. Dias Branco, acreditamos que a qualidade de vida no trabalho e o desenvolvimento das pessoas são essenciais para o nosso sucesso. Por isso, investimos em treinamentos, bem-estar e um ambiente colaborativo, onde cada pessoa é valorizada. Quer crescer com a gente? Vem!

Quem somos

Somos uma das maiores indústrias de alimentos do Brasil, líderes em massas e biscoitos, com mais de 70 anos de história. Marcas como Piraquê, Fit Food, Adria, Jasmine, Frontera, Vitarella, Isabela, Fortaleza, Richester, Puro Sabor, Finna e muitas outras fazem parte da vida de milhões de brasileiros. Temos mais de 17 mil colaboradores, 21 unidades no Brasil, 1 no Uruguai e 28 centros de distribuição, que garantem nossa presença no Brasil e em mais de 40 países pelo mundo.

Nossa atuação e cultura

Atuamos em diversos segmentos de alimentos, com um portfólio que inclui biscoitos, massas, farinhas, margarinas, bolos, snacks, torradas, chocolates, temperos, molhos, granolas, cookies, pasta de amendoim, panificação sem glúten e beneficiamento de grãos.

Valorizamos o respeito às pessoas e à diversidade, por acreditarmos que ela impulsiona resultados e transformações. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, onde todos são respeitados e reconhecidos por sua autenticidade e potencial, independentemente de idade, gênero, etnia ou orientação sexual.

Missão do Cargo:

Coordenar o acompanhamento, controle e execução das atividades do plano de manutenção de equipamentos e instalações, assegurando o melhor desempenho operacional, a redução de perdas por paradas produtivas e a melhoria contínua dos processos, visando otimização de custos e aumento da confiabilidade dos ativos. Além disso, garantir a gestão eficiente do almoxarifado de peças e materiais de manutenção, assegurando disponibilidade, inventários, organização e controle dos estoques, contribuindo diretamente para a eficácia da manutenção preventiva e o pleno funcionamento das operações.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Seus desafios serão:

  • Liderar o cumprimento das atividades de manutenção planejada através do desdobramento das metas de planejamento a toda equipe de manutenção industrial visando otimizar a execução dessas atividades bem como a melhor disponibilidade dos equipamentos;

  • Planejar e cumprir as diretrizes vigentes para a gestão de despesas na manutenção e capital empregado, através da otimização dos recursos, visando reduzir tanto a despesa quanto a estrutura de custos a patamares competitivos;
  • Aprovar e revisar os procedimentos de manutenção, de forma clara e objetiva, padronizando e organizando os processos de manutenção, de maneira a estabelecer a sinergia entre todos os setores;
  • Coordenar a execução do orçamento anual, através do acompanhamento do cumprimento das manutenções preventivas e apoio em projetos;
  • Cumprir os requisitos de sustentabilidade, gestão da qualidade, segurança de alimentos, meio ambiente e segurança e saúde ocupacional.
  • Garantir a disponibilidade de peças e materiais críticos, por meio de gestão eficiente de estoque, análises de criticidade, giro e curva ABC, evitando paradas por falta de componentes;
  • Reduzir custos de estoque, atuando sobre obsolescência, estoque parado;
  • Elevar a acuracidade do almoxarifado, através de controles rígidos de entrada, saída, devolução, inventários e rastreabilidade de peças;
  • Padronizar e organizar o almoxarifado técnico, assegurando correta catalogação, identificação e armazenamento dos materiais;
  • Integrar almoxarifado e PCM, garantindo que as demandas de manutenção preventiva e corretiva estejam alinhadas ao planejamento de materiais;
  • Aumentar a efetividade dos planos de manutenção preventiva, revisando periodicamente frequências, escopos e metodologias com base em dados de desempenho e falhas;
  • Elevar o índice de cumprimento da manutenção preventiva, garantindo execução dentro dos prazos planejados e reduzindo intervenções não programadas;
  • Integrar ferramentas preditivas (vibração, termografia, lubrificação etc.) para aprimorar o planejamento e reduzir falhas recorrentes;
  • Reduzir quebras e intervenções corretivas de emergência, através da melhoria contínua do plano preventivo e da análise sistêmica de falhas;
  • Aprimorar a confiabilidade dos ativos, garantindo que as ações preventivas estejam alinhadas à criticidade dos equipamentos e aos objetivos operacionais;

  • Desejável pós-graduação completa;

Atuamos em 977 municípios de todas as regiões do Brasil, levando energia a mais de 20 milhões de pessoas.

Nosso trabalho mais visível é na distribuição de energia, mas temos muito mais a oferecer. Além das 9 distribuidoras de energia elétrica e 13 concessões de transmissão, contamos com uma central de geração fotovoltaica centralizada e um dos maiores parques de geração distribuída fotovoltaica do país, com a nossa marca inovadora (re)energisa. Também operamos no Mercado Livre de Energia, oferecendo soluções de valor agregado para nossos clientes.

Além disso, diversificamos nosso portfólio com a distribuição e comercialização de gás natural, através da aquisição da ES Gás, e, desde novembro de 2024, com a participação nos ativos da Cegás, Copergás, Algás e Potigás. Estamos também investindo na geração, distribuição e comercialização de bio soluções, como biogás, biometano e biofertilizante, através da Agric.

Nossa missão é transformar energia em conforto, desenvolvimento e novas possibilidades com sustentabilidade. E para isso, contamos com cerca de 17 mil colaboradores que fazem a diferença todos os dias. Você também pode ser parte dessa história de transformação. Vamos juntos construir um mundo mais sustentável?

Auxilia no processo de treinamento e desenvolvimento dos colaboradores (loja e logística) para uso dos recursos e aderência aos processos de movimentação e armazenagem de material;

title: Investment Director Climate Investor 2
description:
Climate Fund Managers B.V. (CFM) is a leading blended finance fund manager dedicated to securing a sustainable future by investing across global emerging markets. CFM has a long-term vision to structure cutting edge financing facilities around thematic areas of climate change mitigation and adaptation, including renewable energy, water and oceans, sustainable land use, and sustainable cities. CFM is established as a joint venture between the Dutch development bank FMO and Sanlam InfraWorks – part of the Sanlam Group of South Africa with offices in The Hague, Cape Town, Windhoek, Singapore and Bogota.

CFM is subject to supervision by the Dutch Authority for the Financial Markets (Autoriteit Financiële Markten or “AFM”) and/or the Dutch Central Bank (De Nederlandsche Bank N.V. or “DNB”) and is authorised to act as investment manager (beheerder ).

Job Purpose

We are seeking an Investment Director to strengthen our Investments and Asset Management team. This role will report to the Regional Head of Latin America and will be ideally based in Brazil (Sao Paulo (preferred) or Rio de Janeiro). The Investment Director will interface CFM divisions and offices.

As a leader in the sustainable finance sector and a pioneer in the renewable energy, water sanitation, oceans infrastructure and green hydrogen sectors, CFM is committed to driving positive environmental impact through strategic investments in climate-related projects. The Investment Director will play a pivotal role in originating and executing on our investment strategies, managing a portfolio of water sanitation, waste valorisation opportunities and oceans infrastructure assets, contributing to the transformation of the LatAm economy and the transition to a more sustainable future.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Management and execution of CI-2 / Climate Investor Two Fund Managers Investment and Fundraising Strategy: Originate investment opportunities that align with the fund’s climate objectives, with a particular emphasis on all themes relevant in the Brazilian market that are in alignment with the CI2 mandate primarily namely water sanitation, waste transformation and oceans infrastructure projects in LatAm, taking into consideration ESG factors and the potential for positive environmental impact.
  • Portfolio Management: Invest and manage a diverse portfolio of water and sanitation and oceans infrastructure assets with a focus on strategic projects to CFM in Brazil.
  • Due Diligence: Conduct thorough due diligence on potential investment opportunities, assessing financial viability, evaluating technology readiness, environmental sustainability, market potential and key risk factors, supported by the regional Latam team.
  • Deal Structuring: Collaborate with the broader investment team to structure deals, negotiate terms, and secure financing for water, sanitation and oceans infrastructure projects in LatAm.
  • Risk Management: Monitor and mitigate risks associated with water, sanitation and oceans infrastructure investments, implementing strategies to preserve capital and maximize returns.
  • Impact Measurement: Maintain robust impact measurement frameworks to track and report on the environmental benefits of investments.
  • Stakeholder Relations: Foster strong relationships with project developers, partners, and stakeholders in the water, sanitation, and oceans infrastructure ecosystem.
  • Compliance: Ensure investments are compliant with all regulatory and ethical guidelines, staying up to date with relevant regulations and industry standards.
  • Fundraising and growth opportunities: Identify and highlight opportunities to seek new capital investors that may align with CFM’s products and growth strategies and support any such initiatives as requested.
  • Team Management: Provide management, mentorship, and guidance to junior investment professionals, promoting a collaborative and growth-oriented work environment as it may be relevant, while interacting closely with other Latam team members based in the region.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Chartered Accountant, CFA or Engineer with MBA or equivalent master’s degree.
  • A minimum of 15‑years of experience in investment banking, corporate finance with a strong track record in deal structuring and financial reporting in the Renewable Energy, Water, Waste to Energy and Oceans Infrastructure sector.
  • Strong analytical, communication and negotiation abilities.
  • English and Spanish language proficiency in addition to native Portuguese.
  • Proven ability to work across technical/financial and legal aspects of a transaction and work with various specialists internally and with government/shareholder/lender type stakeholders to provide transaction leadership.
  • Knowledge of relevant regulations and ESG Principles, compliance requirements, including but not limited to IFRS standards.
  • Ability to plan and prioritise effectively: strong project / process and team management skills.
  • Ability to apply sound business judgment and an analytical, pragmatic, and creative approach to problem solving.
  • Technically proficient (Advanced) in Excel, Word, PowerPoint essential.
  • Experience and significant proven track record of working in Brazil and other LatAm jurisdictions.
  • Work permit and residency in Brazil.

Behavioural Competencies

  • Result-oriented – Being focused on achieving objectives and results, persevering in the face of adversity.
  • Devotion to quality – Demanding a high quality on outputs and acting accordingly.
  • Planning – Systematically organizing activities and setting time frames, setting priorities.
  • Initiative – Identifying opportunities or solutions, and taking action.
  • Analysing and forming opinions – Being focused on examining matters in a systematic way.
  • Cooperation – Working with others in order to effectively contribute to a common objective.
  • Situational Awareness – Being well informed about developments in one's environment and effectively using this information for one's own organisation.
  • Performance under pressure – Maintaining an effective performance under pressure, or when faced with setbacks or disappointment.

Zimmer Biomet Rio de Janeiro Candidatar-se At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.

As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.

What You Can Expect

The Associate Director & Counsel, Global Compliance Investigations, will be responsible for conducting confidential internal investigations on behalf of Zimmer Biomet. This position will report to the Director & Senior Counsel - Americas, Global Compliance Investigations (“GCI”), and will be responsible for investigations in the Latin America (LatAm) region. He/she will work closely and collaboratively with legal and compliance team members in the global and LatAm regional offices, manage outside counsel, as well as external investigation-related vendors and consultants.

How You'll Create Impact

Global Compliance Investigations

  • Evaluate and manage hotline and non-hotline complaints and other potential compliance issues, including assessing the matter upfront, triaging matters to the appropriate team member or function, and developing work plans for items handled by the global compliance investigations team.
  • Leverage other investigation resources as needed, as well as developing findings and memorializing these efforts and final conclusions.
  • Engage and oversee outside counsel, including regular contact with outside counsel, auditors, consultants and vendors.
  • Work with the Director & Senior Counsel – Americas, GCI, to prepare and present findings of all investigations to relevant disciplinary committees and other relevant stakeholders.
  • Work with the Director & Senior Counsel – Americas, GCI, to provide regular updates on investigations and findings to the Vice President, Global Compliance Investigations, Chief Compliance Officer, General Counsel, and other senior leadership as appropriate.

Other

  • Actively monitor developments related to compliance, anticorruption enforcement, and other compliance-related matters, discussing with team members and drafting summaries/updates for external stakeholders.
  • Analyze investigative trends and update relevant stakeholders in the region.
  • Remain up-to-date on relevant trends and activities in the global compliance sphere within the life sciences industry.

What Makes You Stand Out

Expected Areas of Competence (i.e., knowledge, skills and abilities)

  • Experience conducting and/or participating in investigation interviews or depositions.
  • Detail oriented, with a high degree of ethics, integrity, discretion, and professionalism.
  • Strong writing, editing and analytical skills, including a command of grammar and style conventions.
  • Experience drafting investigation-related documents, including interview memoranda, document review protocols, investigation reports and presentations.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize multiple tasks.
  • Highly motivated, self‑starter willing to meet strict deadlines and time constraints.
  • Strong leadership presence and ability to manage people and projects effectively.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently and work as part of a team, able to build relationships across and outside the department.
  • Ability to communicate effectively to a diverse audience at multiple levels within the company through various formats.
  • Excellent note‑taking skills.
  • Familiarity with forensic accounting, US GAAP, and payment systems (such as SAP) a plus.
  • Must be fluent in English and Spanish; Portuguese language skills a plus.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

Your Background

Education/Experience Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree.
  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience, with a strong preference for experience with compliance and conducting internal investigations, including FCPA‑related investigations, ideally for multinational companies in the health care/life sciences industry.
  • Experience with investigations in the Latin America region highly preferred.
