Como Analista de Patrimônio você será responsável pela gestão e controle dos ativos do grupo, garantindo acuracidade no inventário, atendimento às normas internas e ao compliance. Atuará na criação e manutenção de processos que assegurem a rastreabilidade, conservação e otimização do uso dos bens, apoiando diretamente áreas estratégicas como Operações, Financeiro, Contábil e Fiscal.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar o inventário físico e contábil dos ativos das duas unidades de negócio, assegurando conciliação com registros em sistema;
  • Implementar e manter processos de controle de equipamentos em comodato, garantindo a rastreabilidade e integridade dos itens;
  • Estruturar e gerir o processo de transferência de equipamentos entre lojas e entre lojas e galpão;
  • Auxiliar no processo de compras de equipamentos, observando as normas e critérios definidos;
  • Manter atualizado o cadastro de ativos no sistema de gestão patrimonial;
  • Apoiar a área contábil na conciliação patrimonial, baixas, depreciação e ajustes de ativos;
  • Garantir conformidade com exigências fiscais e auditorias internas/externas relacionadas ao imobilizado;
  • Desenvolver relatórios gerenciais periódicos sobre movimentações, depreciação, investimentos e status dos ativos;
  • Propor melhorias contínuas nos processos de controle patrimonial, visando maior eficiência, segurança e redução de custos;
  • Apoiar a área financeira no planejamento de investimentos em ativos;
  • Acompanhar a manutenção preventiva e corretiva de equipamentos, em conjunto com a área de Operações;
  • Suportar demandas de auditoria interna e externa, fornecendo documentação e evidências sobre o patrimônio;
  • Apoiar na avaliação de obsolescência e descarte de ativos;
  • Acompanhar e controlar investimentos em novos projetos e reformas de lojas, assegurando correta classificação entre CAPEX e OPEX;
  • Identificação de riscos operacionais e proposição de controles internos no ciclo de vida do ativo.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação superior em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia, Engenharia de Produção ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia em gestão patrimonial, controle de ativos ou áreas contábil/financeira;
  • Conhecimento em normas contábeis aplicáveis ao imobilizado;
  • Habilidade em Excel avançado e sistemas ERP (ex.: SAP, TOTVS, Linx ou similares);
  • Boa capacidade analítica e de comunicação para interação com diversas áreas;
  • Conhecimento prático de CPC 27 (Ativo Imobilizado).

title: Professor de Inglês  - Rio de Janeiro
description:
A Cultura Inglesa é para todos!

Todas as nossas vagas são afirmativas para a inclusão e diversidade, e estão esperando a sua Inscrição!

A Cultura Inglesa é uma empresa inovadora e que sonha em projetar o Brasil no cenário global através da educação, formando cada vez mais cidadãos confiantes e fluentes no inglês. Somos um centro de intercâmbio cultural que utiliza teatro, música, dança e todas as formas de arte como ferramenta de ensino. Somos referência no ensino da língua inglesa, com mais de 90 anos de atuação e com excelência neste segmento. Dispomos de uma estrutura completa de desenvolvimento de tecnologia e material didático. Adotamos uma postura empreendedora, aprimorando de forma constante nossos produtos e serviços, e atuamos com pioneirismo em técnicas de ensino, pois acreditamos na inovação dentro da educação.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Professor de Inglês dedicado(a) e com vontade de impactar positivamente a trajetória de aprendizado de nossos alunos. Se você é alguém que se importa com o desenvolvimento acadêmico e cultural dos estudantes e possui um bom domínio da língua inglesa, essa pode ser a oportunidade ideal para você!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Principais responsabilidades

  • Garantir o progresso dos alunos no aprendizado da língua inglesa, por meio de aulas bem preparadas e conduzidas com excelência, seguindo os padrões da instituição.
  • Acompanhar o desempenho dos estudantes, com base na participação em aula, nas atividades propostas e no engajamento com a plataforma LXP (atividades assíncronas), oferecendo feedback constante e suporte acadêmico personalizado para alunos e/ou responsáveis.
  • Participar de treinamentos para o aprimoramento contínuo das suas habilidades pedagógicas e administrativas.
  • Promover a cultura, participando e incentivando a adesão a eventos culturais oferecidos pela instituição.
  • Apoiar o atendimento ao público, auxiliando na avaliação de nível de novos alunos e colaborando com o setor administrativo com seu conhecimento acadêmico.
  • Contribuir para a satisfação e fidelização dos alunos, por meio de um atendimento atencioso, acompanhamento constante e excelência na entrega de resultados.

Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos

  • Domínio linguístico da língua inglesa (nível C1), com excelente comunicação oral e escrita.
  • Experiência prévia em ensino de inglês, com grupos diversos (adultos, crianças e adolescentes).

Diferenciais

  • Formação em Bacharelado em Letras ou áreas afins, ou certificação CELTA ou equivalente.
  • Certificados de proficiência (CPE, por exemplo).

Informações adicionais

O que oferecemos

  • Assistência médica

title: HSS & Signalling Engineer
description:
Company Overview

1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider, delivering global connectivity solutions to enterprises and consumers. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform - including its own owned and operated global mobile core network, fully fledged in-house developed eSIM technology, and an extensive portfolio of telecom licenses - 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider across 40 countries worldwide.

We serve many of the world's leading banks, enterprises, and digital-first businesses, including neo-banks, global fast moving consumer goods companies, travel leaders, and payment service providers. Today, 1GLOBAL connects more than 70 million people and devices globally, enabling our customers to launch, scale, and innovate with confidence in the mobile ecosystem.

1GLOBAL is a profitable, fast-growing business. With full-year revenues in 2025 exceeding US$200 million and profits of over US$25 million, we generate strong cash flows to fund our growth allowing us to continuously invest in infrastructure, platform innovation, and global expansion. Recent years have marked a defining phase in our journey, with major enterprise and mass-consumer client wins accelerating our evolution into a global mobile connectivity powerhouse, purpose-built to enable consumer brands to enter and succeed with their own aspirations to offer telecommunications services to their clients.

Founded in 2022 by experienced technology entrepreneurs, Hakan Koçand Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL has rapidly emerged as a European technology leader shaping the future of global telecommunications. We operate as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) in 12 countries and as a regulated telecom operator in an additional 28 markets. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, our team of close to 500 experts across 15 countries is united by a single ambition: to redefine global mobile connectivity through technology, scale, and execution excellence.

About the Team

As a Network Engineering member, in the Signalling functional area, you will be responsible for proposing, analysing, and defining the requirements for new and existing services and systems related to the signalling routing area and subscriber data management systems under the responsibility of the functional area. Prepare, design, test and provide new solutions or product changes of the already existing portfolio. Define and support the technology evolution roadmap for the systems under the functional area. Participate and support the other functional areas in cross functional projects.

About the Role

  • Collaboration with other Network teams in defining and managing the projects for delivery of new solutions
  • Project delivery, network design, integration, and migration strategy definition. Collaboration with other relevant departments and responsible for end-to-end delivery
  • Design of new consumer and corporate telecom solutions
  • Creation of technical documentation (HLD's, LLD's, WO's, etc.) and maintain it over the lifecycle of the solutions
  • Perform implementations in live environment and understand end-to-end system testing requirements
  • Follow-up and define quality and performance indicators
  • Capacity and performance analysis, reporting and improvement solution definition
  • Service & resource configuration definition and implementation on requested systems
  • Work on complex solutions that influence the design of current products and address design issues for future products or technologies
  • Maintain close relationship with external partners like carriers, service providers
  • Elaborate and manage the process for change requests to current partners to meet network necessities
  • Control the network elements roadmap and be responsible for necessary software/hardware upgrades during component lifecycle
  • Generate and implement process improvements, including cross-team processes
  • Document the existing technology portfolio and propose recommendations for improvements and/or alternatives

Requirements

About You

  • Proven experience implementing live solutions on mobile telecom (GSM, UMTS, LTE, IMS), networks design, capacity management, engineering and architecture
  • Knowledge of 3GPP, GSMA, ITU standards and specifications
  • Experience designing, testing and operating signalling network functions, including STPs, DEA/DRAs and HLR/HSS
  • Experience defining, establishing and maintaining signalling interconnects, SIGTRAN and DIAMETER based, using SCTP multi-homing
  • Experience with HLR/HSS, subscriber profiles, subscriber repositories and respective reference interfaces
  • Knowledge of IMS architecture, including Application Servers and interaction with profile repositories
  • Experience in mobile services charging (online). Knowledge and experience of Ro, Gy, Gx interfaces
  • Knowledge and experience with signalling protocols and routing including M3UA, M2PA, DIAMETER, as well as upper layer protocols such as MAP, CAMEL, Sh, Cx
  • Knowledge of 5G SA networks, from a signalling (SCP and SEPP) and AUSF/UDM/UDR perspective
  • Experience with protocol analyser tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot network error/problem for the mentioned protocols
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape
  • English proficiency mandatory; other languages are a plus
  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience

Nice-to-haves

  • +3 years working on telecoms, designing and implementing mobile core networks
  • Previous experience with Nokia, Oracle, HPE products

Benefits

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses — to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Extended parental leave — 180 days maternity leave and 20 days paternity leave
  • Daycare allowance — provided to mothers with children under 3 years old, R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities — Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs
  • Major Transaction Exposure — Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry
  • Work with a Talented Team — From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly be exposed to talented and driven individuals
  • Dynamic Work Environment — Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts
  • Professional Development — Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field
  • International Experience — Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company
  • Open Communication Culture — Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment
  • Get Things Done Attitude — Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer; we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

description:
Descrição

Buscamos um(a) Analista de SOC Pleno para atuar na linha de frente da Segurança da Informação, sendo responsável pelo monitoramento contínuo, correlação de eventos, detecção de ameaças e resposta a incidentes. Este(a) profissional atuará diretamente com ferramentas de segurança, colaborará com diferentes áreas técnicas e contribuirá para o fortalecimento da postura de segurança da organização.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Monitorar eventos de segurança em tempo real, utilizando ferramentas de SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS e outras soluções corporativas.
  • Investigar alertas e incidentes, conduzindo análises profundas (deep dive) e propondo ações de contenção, erradicação e recuperação.
  • Correlacionar eventos entre múltiplas ferramentas de segurança (SIEM, EDR, DLP, Firewall, Cloud Security, entre outros).
  • Criar, revisar e evoluir playbooks, runbooks e procedimentos operacionais de resposta a incidentes.
  • Analisar artefatos maliciosos, logs de rede, tráfego suspeito, comportamentos anômalos e possíveis violações.
  • Produzir relatórios técnicos e executivos sobre incidentes, tendências de ameaças e postura de segurança.
  • Interagir com times de TI, Infraestrutura, Redes, Cloud e Engenharia para remediação e aprimoramento de controles.
  • Colaborar na melhoria contínua dos processos de monitoramento, governança de alertas e ajustes de regras em ferramentas de segurança.
  • Acompanhar tendências de ameaças, TTPs e ferramentas de ataque, sugerindo melhorias no ambiente.
  • Auxiliar na implementação e manutenção de ferramentas de segurança e projetos relacionados ao SOC.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência prática em ambientes de SOC, com ferramentas como SIEM, EDR e IDS/IPS e Threat Intelligence.
  • Familiaridade com frameworks de segurança como MITRE ATT&CK, NIST e CIS.
  • Experiência mínima de 1 ano em Cibersegurança, Segurança da Informação ou atuação em SOC/NOC.
  • Conhecimento sólido em análise de logs, tráfego de rede, protocolos (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS etc.) e investigação de incidentes.
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas como: SIEM (Splunk, QRadar, Sentinel, Elastic etc.), EDR (CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Defender for Endpoint etc.), IDS/IPS, WAF, DLP e soluções de Threat Intelligence.
  • Familiaridade com frameworks e metodologias: MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF, CIS Controls.
  • Conhecimento em redes, criptografia, proxies, firewalls e operações de segurança.
  • Boa comunicação para interação entre áreas e produção de relatórios técnicos/executivos.

description:

Como Gerente de PMO para Programa de Transformação Digital você vai: Liderar o PMO de um Programa de Transformação Digital, garantindo governança sólida, entregas previsíveis e coordenação eficaz entre múltiplas frentes de trabalho. Estas equipes ficam responsáveis pelo acompanhamento de um número definido de famílias de áreas geográficas delimitadas, atuando com ações de prevenção e promoção à saúde dessa comunidade.

As equipes da ESF são compostas por Médico Generalista ou Médico de Família e Comunidade, Enfermeiro, Auxiliar ou Técnico de Enfermagem e Agentes Comunitários de Saúde (ACS).

Também há equipe de Saúde Bucal, composta por cirurgião-dentista generalista ou especialista em saúde da família, auxiliar e/ou técnico em Saúde Bucal.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Realizar atendimento na Estratégia Saúde da Família, conforme as diretrizes da Secretaria Municipal da Saúde e protocolos existentes. Realizar assistência à população sob o âmbito da promoção e proteção da saúde, prevenção de agravos, diagnóstico, tratamento, reabilitação e manutenção da saúde individual, coletiva e incluindo ações no domicilio. Realizar interface com a Rede Assistencial à Saúde, atuando de forma integral na coordenação do cuidado, através de ações que facilitem o acesso, integralidade, longitudinalidade, resolutividade e a participação da comunidade nos Serviços de Saúde.

description:

Overview

We are seeking a Fraud Investigator to join the Internal Special Audits Division.

The Internal Special Audits Division is responsible for conducting highly sensitive investigations into issues involving fraud, conflicts of interest, waste, and abuse to provide the management and the Board of Directors with reports, analyses, recommendations, and information concerning the activities reviewed. The Special Audits Division also helps addressing fraud risk management across the Company with programs of awareness, policy and risk consulting, and proactive risk mitigation measures.

Your primary role is to conduct confidential investigations involving misconduct by employees and contractors, while seeking to identify and develop relevant facts.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead or support time‑sensitive investigations.
  • Become familiar with and utilize data mining and analytical techniques to both identify potential fraud and gather corroborating evidence to support investigations.
  • Become familiar with and utilize Enterprise Risk Management tools (i.e., SAP) to obtain data in support of investigations.
  • Provide fraud awareness presentations throughout the Company to varying job specialties and levels of management.
  • Liaise and coordinate with other fraud‑related stakeholder departments including Corporate Security, Law, Personnel and Labor Relations.
  • Draft timely investigative reports and verbally communicate results.
  • Provide on‑the‑job training and mentoring to less experienced staff.
  • Work independently yet effectively within a team of experienced professionals.
  • As a successful candidate, you will hold a bachelor degree in accounting, finance, human resources, law, criminology, compliance, computer. An advanced degree is a plus.
  • You will have a minimum of 10 years of experience in forensic accounting, fraud investigation, auditing, law enforcement, compliance, or a related field where you utilized and developed expert interviewing and investigative techniques.
  • You will have at least one professional certification, such as the Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE), Professional Certified Investigator (PCI), Certified Compliance & Ethics Professional (CCEP), Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) and Certified Public Accountant (CPA).
  • You must demonstrate excellent verbal and written communication skills in English with solid presentation and interpersonal skills.
  • You should be able to quickly evaluate allegations of fraud, abuse and conflicts of interest and determine the violation of the law, regulations, or Company policy.
  • You should have effective and modern investigative techniques to quickly unravel, explain, and report complicated fraud and conflicts of interest schemes.
  • You should be able to analyze facts and evidence and form evidence‑based conclusions concerning violations of the law, regulations, or Company policy.

Working environment

Our high‑performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

At Aramco, our people work on truly world‑scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world’s biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector‑specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

Aramco energizes the world economy

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer. With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

title: Human Resource Administrator
description:
The Company

Katalyst Data Management (KDM) provides end-to-end subsurface data management solutions for the oil and gas industry. From data capture and verification to data storage and organization, to marketing data online, our specialized data services cater for small enterprises, through to large multinational and corporate data centers. KDM’s web-based iGlass services and their related controls, including system redundancy, are key differentiators in providing and maintaining high availability, 24/7 access for customers. Innovation and commitment have enabled KDM to provide excellence in both technologies and service qualities.

Key Responsibilities and Accountabilities

The Human Resources Administrator provides day-to-day administrative and operational support across core Human Resources functions in Brazil, ensuring compliance with Brazilian labor legislation (CLT), applicable collective bargaining agreements, and internal company policies. This role supports employee lifecycle processes including onboarding/offboarding, employee record maintenance, benefits administration support, recruitment coordination, HR reporting, and employee inquiry response. The HR Administrator handles confidential employee information in accordance with the Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados (LGPD) and maintains accurate documentation required for audits and statutory reporting.

Tasks

  • Support the end-to-end onboarding and offboarding process, including collection and validation of mandatory personal documents, coordination of pre-employment medical examinations (ASO), and preparation/maintenance of employment documentation.
  • Maintain accurate physical and digital employee personnel files (contracts, amendments, acknowledgements, and supporting documentation) and ensure records are up to date.
  • Coordinate HR data entry, updates, and reporting in HRIS (e.g., ADP WorkforceNow or local systems) and support required submissions and recordkeeping for Brazil (e.g., eSocial data coordination as applicable).
  • Provide administrative support for benefits and statutory programs, responding to employee questions regarding benefits and leave (e.g., vacation scheduling, meal/transportation vouchers where applicable) and routing complex items to HR leadership or vendors.
  • Coordinate recruitment administration, including job postings support, interview scheduling, candidate communications, and onboarding logistics.
  • Support compliance activities by tracking key dates and documents (e.g., probationary period checkpoints, contract renewals for fixed-term hires, and required acknowledgements).
  • Assist with internal HR communications and policy administration, including distribution of policies, collection of employee acknowledgements, and maintaining policy records.
  • Partner with local stakeholders (e.g., accounting/payroll providers) to support timely processing by providing accurate employee data and documentation, while maintaining confidentiality and data privacy controls.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of HR administrative processes, templates, and checklists to increase accuracy, speed, and compliance readiness.

Compliance and Data Privacy (Brazil)

  • Work is performed in alignment with CLT requirements and any applicable collective bargaining agreements, including proper documentation of the employment relationship.
  • Maintain confidentiality and process personal data in accordance with LGPD principles (purpose limitation, necessity, security, and accountability).
  • Support accurate recordkeeping needed for statutory obligations and inspections, escalating questions to HR leadership or legal counsel as appropriate.

Skills and Knowledge

  • Working knowledge of core HR administration practices and familiarity with Brazilian Labor concepts (CLT) and HR documentation standards.
  • High attention to detail, strong organization, and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Professional communication skills: English proficiency (written and verbal) required.
  • Discretion and integrity when handling confidential employee information and sensitive issues.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook) and comfort learning HRIS/payroll portals.
  • Strong customer-service orientation and ability to work collaboratively with employees and cross-functional partners.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This position has no supervisory responsibilities; however, it provides administrative support and guidance to employees on HR processes and directs questions to appropriate stakeholders when needed.

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work

This is a full-time position. As such, the Human Resource Administrator is eligible to participate in the regional benefits program offered to Katalyst employees.

Standard days and hours of work are Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., with flexibility as needed to support business requirements and local timekeeping practices.

Travel

Occasional local travel may be required for this position. If an offsite meeting or errand is requested, eligible mileage reimbursement will follow company policy and applicable local guidance.

Required Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Three (3) to five (5) years of experience in HR administration, HR operations, or a similar role.
  • Experience supporting onboarding documentation, personnel file maintenance, and benefits/employee inquiries.
  • Experience working with HRIS platforms (e.g., ADP WorkforceNow) and coordinating HR data updates and reporting. HR certification or coursework (local or international) is a plus.

Resumes can be submitted to our Career Center by visiting our Katalyst Career Center.

title: Revenue Manager
description:
Company Overview

Sofitel is a pioneering French luxury hospitality brand founded in 1964. It brings French zest and inspires heartfelt encounters to the most sought‑after destinations worldwide. By seamlessly melding local culture with French zest for life through remarkable savoir‑faire and generous service, Sofitel caters to free‑minded travelers and arts and culture aficionados who appreciate a refined and understated sense of modern luxury.

Hotel Overview

The Sofitel Rio de Janeiro Ipanema, a landmark for Sofitel in the Americas, re‑emerges as a revitalized beachfront icon where French elegance meets the vibrant Carioca lifestyle. Designed as a sanctuary of art, craftsmanship, and sensory experiences, the hotel sets a new benchmark for luxury hospitality in Rio de Janeiro. It features 172 rooms and suites with the signature Sofitel MyBed, refined art‑filled interiors, and sweeping views of Two Brothers Hill. Guests enjoy an elevated dining experience at the 22nd‑floor Chef’s Table, a rooftop infinity pool, wellness spa, Beach Club, and the exclusive Club Millésime lounge for personalized service and private check‑in. The design vision is led by Brazilian architect Patricia Anastassiadis, whose storytelling approach blends heritage, artistry, and contemporary sophistication, creating spaces that feel both meaningful and deeply connected to place. Set beneath the iconic Christ the Redeemer, Sofitel Rio de Janeiro Ipanema stands as the ultimate destination for discerning travelers where luxury meets the true soul of Rio.

Revenue Manager Responsibilities

As the Revenue Manager, you will lead the development and execution of strategic revenue initiatives designed to maximize room revenue, total hotel profitability, and market share. You will leverage strong analytical expertise and commercial acumen to drive data‑informed pricing, forecasting, and distribution decisions. Working in close collaboration with Sales, Marketing, and Operations, you will ensure optimal commercial alignment, performance optimization, and sustainable revenue growth across all segments.

Revenue Strategy & Optimization

  • Develop and implement comprehensive revenue management strategies to maximize room revenue, total hotel profitability, and market share.
  • Drive dynamic pricing strategies based on demand patterns, seasonality, booking pace, and market trends.
  • Continuously evaluate performance and adjust tactical and strategic approaches to optimize results.

Forecasting & Budgeting

  • Prepare accurate daily, weekly, and monthly forecasts using historical data, market intelligence, and forward‑looking demand indicators.
  • Actively participate in the annual budgeting process, providing strategic insights and revenue projections.
  • Conduct variance analysis and present actionable recommendations to senior management.

Distribution Channel Management

  • Oversee and optimize all distribution channels, including OTA, direct, GDS, corporate, and wholesale segments.
  • Ensure a balanced and profitable channel mix, minimizing distribution costs while maximizing net revenue contribution.
  • Monitor channel performance and implement strategies to drive direct bookings and improve channel efficiency.

Market Analysis & Competitive Benchmarking

  • Analyze market trends, competitor performance, and industry dynamics using tools such as STR reports and other market intelligence platforms.
  • Identify revenue opportunities and proactively mitigate potential risks.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of the competitive landscape to support strategic positioning.

Commercial Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Director of Commercial to align pricing strategies with promotional campaigns and sales initiatives.
  • Provide revenue guidance and analytical support for corporate, group, and MICE contract negotiations to ensure profitability.

Systems & Data Management

  • Manage revenue management systems and ensure data accuracy and integrity across PMS, CRS, RMS, and distribution platforms.
  • Leverage technology and automation tools to enhance forecasting precision and operational efficiency.

Reporting & Performance Monitoring

  • Deliver regular revenue performance reports to the General Manager and regional leadership.
  • Monitor and analyze key KPIs including RevPAR, ADR, Occupancy, GOP.
  • Translate data into strategic insights to drive informed decision‑making.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop the revenue team to achieve high‑performance standards.
  • Foster a strong data‑driven and analytical culture within the department, promoting continuous improvement and commercial excellence.

Qualifications / What You Will Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality, Business, Finance, or related field (Master’s preferred).
  • Strong knowledge of luxury hospitality market dynamics (leisure, MICE, corporate, wholesale).
  • Expertise in forecasting, pricing strategy, yield management, and distribution optimization.
  • Analytical mindset with excellent attention to detail.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and cross‑department collaboration skills.
  • Strategic thinker with hands‑on execution capability.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese.
  • Leadership experience in managing and developing high‑performing teams.

Informações adicionais

  • Express entrepreneurial spirit and leadership while embodying the French Art de Vivre.
  • Demonstrate humble excellence through a distinguished presence, refined savoir‑faire, and meticulous attention to detail (Cousu Main).
  • Be a passionate team player — warm, sociable, and genuinely caring toward others.
  • Exhibit a strong sense of luxury by creating meaningful stories, rituals, and traditions.
  • Embrace a true Francophile mindset, showing curiosity and appreciation for French language, culture, history, and cuisine.
  • Demonstrate open‑mindedness, creativity, and a spirit of innovation.
  • Act as a cultural link by engaging with local arts, gastronomy, fashion, and contemporary design.
  • Champion committed luxury with a strong sense of care and responsibility.

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Basic Function

Reporting to the Assistant Vice President of Multimedia & Digital Communications, in the Office of University Communications, the Videographer/Multimedia Specialist is responsible for planning, directing, and conducting video and photo shoots both in studio and on location. The role involves capturing content related to Howard University leadership, campus events, activities, and meetings. The position also entails producing storytelling content that aligns with the University’s brand identity and supports its reputation. Strong storytelling abilities, technical proficiency, and photography skills are required to create various types of digital and long‑form video content to address institutional objectives.

Supervisory Accountability

Supervises student interns as needed. No other accountabilities are projected in this role.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include faculty, staff, administrators, students and University leadership. External contacts include vendors, partners, and alumni.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Develops visual/audiovisual/still photography strategies to support the brand identity of Howard University.
  • Collaborates with Office of University Communications (OUC) team members to conceptualize and plan video solutions to meet institutional goals and objectives.
  • Attends and contributes to regular meetings within the Office of University Communications.
  • Works collaboratively with digital content producers across the University, including faculty, staff, and students.
  • Plans, directs, and executes video and photo shoots in studio and on location.
  • Demonstrates the ability to handle all phases of assigned projects from concept through final delivery.
  • Demonstrates strong photography skills for an adaptive environment when photography needs are required.
  • Edits and color grades projects using non‑linear software such as Adobe Lightroom, Premiere, etc.
  • Engages approved freelance support as needed.
  • Independently provides stylized, creative content within the University’s brand guidelines.
  • Grasp of best practices for accessibility, captioning, and SRT files.
  • Communicates effectively with staff and internal and external stakeholders to ensure effective, relevant and timely completion of assignments.
  • Research and provides advice on the latest industry‑related practices and technologies.
  • Transports equipment and/or travel to locations via personal vehicle or University transportation to assignments.
  • Manages and catalogues content in the internal digital asset management system.
  • Conducts routine equipment maintenance.
  • Successfully manages multiple projects.
  • Performs additional duties as assigned.

Core Competencies

  • Experience with directing on‑camera talent, participants, or personalities is a strong plus.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to work in various positions on a production crew.
  • Strength in creativity, organization, attention to detail, and ability to function as part of a team independently with specific or ambiguous direction.
  • Experience using Canon ecosystem a plus.
  • Strong production and post‑production skills.
  • Knowledge of current and emerging trends in social media, generative AI, AI workflows, streaming platforms, and digital video marketing is a big plus.
  • Experience capturing both portrait‑style content and live event coverage is a strong plus.
  • Experience setting up and managing audio for video productions.
  • Some familiarity with generative AI production workflows, including but not limited to Midjourney, KIng, Suno, Google Labs (Veo/Flow, etc), and other emerging tools. Ability to integrate these technologies into storytelling, ideation, and post‑production pipelines is a major plus.
  • Ability to consistently meet deadlines, successfully multi‑task, and work within established brand/product guidelines.
  • Computer proficient and proficient in non‑linear editing, Adobe Premiere, Adobe After Effects, and related software.
  • Proficient in visual production and design software, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, and Adobe Lightroom.
  • General administrative software programs including Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, FTP clients, general internet search, and research skills.
  • Strong drive and initiative. Self‑motivated.
  • Media file management and organization and understanding of multiple digital media formats, codecs, and containers.
  • Strong communication skills.
  • Animation skills are a plus but not required.
  • Understands the power of feedback and input on projects.
  • Positive, professional attitude and strong team player.

Minimum Requirements

A bachelor’s degree in photography, film, video production, or a related field. 2 or more years of general production experience, including shooting, interviewing, recording, editing and finished professional quality video media. Ability to work outside of normal business hours, including travel outside of the area.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Apoiar pipeline na identificação, definição e implementação de casos de uso para Sistemas de Armazenamento de Energia em Baterias (BESS) em locais centralizados e/ou distribuídos.
  • Dar suporte técnico em todas as fases dos projetos de Sistemas de Armazenamento de Energia em Baterias (BESS), como:

Nossas equipes de logística estão mudando a maneira como interagimos com clientes em todo o mundo todos os dias e resolvendo alguns dos maiores desafios logísticos enfrentados não apenas pela Amazon, mas também por toda a indústria. Sejam itens grandes ou pequenos, encontramos soluções para garantir que estamos cumprindo nossa promessa para os clientes. A equipe da Amazon Logistics Brasil (AMZL) está procurando uma pessoa Líder de Operações Logísticas para se juntar ao time de Parceiros Logísticos Externos da Amazon. As operações serão feitas 7 dias por semana, incluindo feriados; portanto, trabalhar em diferentes turnos será parte dessa função. Atuará na gestão de uma equipe de parceiros logísticos externos, como também gerenciará uma equipe de analistas de operações logísticas, que também serão funcionários Amazon, para garantir o desempenho e conformidade dos processos desses parceiros. Trabalhará em um ambiente altamente colaborativo que é mais próximo de uma start-up do que uma grande empresa. A atitude adotada é que nenhuma ideia é uma má ideia e as melhores ideias são aquelas que devem ser testadas e experimentadas. Essa pessoa será responsável por monitorar o desempenho e a conformidade dos parceiros logísticos, em coordenação com times internos e externos. Também será responsável por apoiar os lançamentos de novos parceiros logísticos. O trabalho exige alguém que tenha grande disposição para assumir responsabilidades, tenha habilidades para identificar padrões e tendências, juntamente com a capacidade de examinar detalhes e analisar dados, aprofundando-se nas causas raízes dos problemas operacionais e propondo soluções.

Key Job Responsibilities

  • Fazer a gestão do time de Analista Operações Logísticas;
  • Ponto focal de relacionamento e acompanhamento de métricas dos parceiros logísticos responsáveis pelas estações de entregas;
  • Acompanhamento dos treinamentos e projetos de melhorias dos parceiros logísticos;
  • Criar e acompanhar métricas operacionais com os parceiros logísticos;
  • Analisar dados de várias fontes e identificar tendências relevantes para que, a partir deles, decisões rápidas e importantes ao negócio sejam tomadas;
  • Encontrar soluções práticas e simples para problemas complexos;
  • Servir de elo entre os stakeholders internos e externos tendo em vista os objetivos, limites, conformidade e privacidade das informações;
  • Mergulhar profundamente nas causas raízes dos problemas operacionais.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent;
  • Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays;
  • Speak, write, and read fluently in English;
  • Experience in employee and performance management;

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with performance metrics and process improvement and Lean techniques;

title: Outlet Manager
description:
Company Description

Emerging as a pioneering French luxury hospitality brand in 1964, Sofitel brings French zest and inspires heartfelt encounters to the most sought-after destinations worldwide. Seamlessly melding local culture with the French zest for life through remarkable savoir-faire and generous service, Sofitel is for free‑minded travelers and arts and culture aficionados who have an appreciation for a refined and understated sense of modern luxury.

Sofitel Rio de Janeiro Ipanema is a landmark for Sofitel in the Americas. The property features 172 rooms and suites with the signature Sofitel MyBed, refined art‑filled interiors, and sweeping views of Two Brothers Hill. Guests enjoy elevated dining at the 22nd‑floor Chef’s Table, a rooftop infinity pool, wellness spa, Beach Club, and the exclusive Club Millésime lounge for personalized service and private check‑in.

Job Description

We are seeking a dynamic and results‑driven Outlet Manager to lead the daily operations of our established Sel d'Ipanema Beach Club while supporting the F&B Manager in the pre‑opening development of the F&B division at Sofitel Ipanema . This role requires a hands‑on leader with strong financial acumen, leadership, operational expertise, and a passion for delivering exceptional guest experiences in an upscale hospitality environment.

  • Manage the day‑to‑day operations of Sel d'Ipanema Beach Club;
  • Ensure service excellence aligned with brand standards and guest expectations;
  • Monitor and control Food & Beverage costs, labor costs, and daily revenue performance;
  • Drive revenue growth through upselling, team training, and operational efficiency;
  • Supervise reservation flow and optimize seating capacity;
  • Maintain strict inventory control and support purchasing processes;
  • Ensure compliance with health, safety, and sanitation regulations;
  • Monitor guest satisfaction scores and online reputation;
  • Handle guest concerns promptly and professionally;
  • Support the F&B Manager in pre‑opening activities for the hotel’s outlets;
  • Assist with SOP implementation, onboarding and team training;
  • Participate in soft opening preparation and execution.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or related field;
  • Proven experience as Outlet Manager or Assistant F&B Manager in upscale or luxury hospitality;
  • Strong understanding of P&L and cost control principles;
  • Leadership skills with the ability to motivate and develop teams;
  • Commercial mindset with focus on revenue optimization;
  • Excellent communication and problem‑solving skills;
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese;
  • Ability to perform in high‑volume, fast‑paced environments;
  • Pre‑opening experience is a plus.

Additional Information

  • Express entrepreneurial spirit and leadership while embodying the French Art de Vivre;
  • Demonstrate humble excellence through a distinguished presence, refined savoir-faire, and meticulous attention to detail (Cousu Main);
  • Be a passionate team player — warm, sociable, and genuinely caring toward others;
  • Exhibit a strong sense of luxury by creating meaningful stories, rituals, and traditions;
  • Embrace a true Francophile mindset, showing curiosity and appreciation for French language, culture, history, and cuisine;
  • Demonstrate open‑mindedness, creativity, and a spirit of innovation;
  • Act as a cultural link by engaging with local arts, gastronomy, fashion, and contemporary design;
  • Champion committed luxury with a strong sense of care and responsibility.

Conheça o Modelo De Contrato Intermitente

  • A modalidade de contrato intermitente é regido pela CLT e a carteira de trabalho do empregado é assinada normalmente;

  • O empregado recebe apenas pelas horas efetivamente trabalhadas, sem salário fixo mensal.

title: Assistant, Local Content
description:
Local Content is a Brazilian federal policy, enforced by the National Agency of Petroleum, Natural Gas, and Biofuels (ANP), that requires operators involved in field development in Brazil to engage with Brazilian suppliers for local goods and services on projects related to the exploration and development stages. Governed by ANP Resolution No. 19, this requirement is referred toas “Local Content,” and is defined as a percentage of the contractual value to be provided by the Brazilian industry.

In order to demonstrate compliance with the contractual Local Content requirements set by ANP, certification of the content is necessary. For this job, the person performs Local Content Certification activities for Goods, Materials, Labor Services and Set and works closely with Local Content analysts, promoting the measurement/calculation of costs, values and origin of the tax documentation that makes up the scope of the certification work.

What You Will Do:

  • Under direct and indirect supervision, performs work involving conventional practices for Local Content certification, which may include problem solving.
  • Responsible for the assessment of projects designated by the Supervisor or Manager.
  • Completion of ANP spreadsheets, with the consolidation of costs and values determined and Local Content Certificates and Verification Report.
  • Works with the Client on a day-to-day basis, for clarifications, updates and requests for pending issues.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Higher education students or recent graduates in Business, Economics, Accounting or Engineering.
  • Intermediate English preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Needs to be familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality and Environmental Management System.
  • Excellent organizational skills.
  • Microsoft Excel at Intermediate level.
  • Ability to work well with others.

Reporting Relationships:

Reportsto the Local Content Supervisor or to the Local Content Manager.

title: Regional Parntership Manager, WFS
description:
The Workforce Staffing (WFS) Candidate Attraction team is looking for a Regional Partnerships Manager. The primary responsibility of the Regional Partnerships Manager is to build relationships and manage communications with community partners across Mexico. Their primary focus is to foster and build relationships with workforce organizations in the community to source candidates for entry-level warehouse role. In addition to their region, they will also manage national workforce relationships, while building a network of regionally based partners in specific risk markets. This team facilitates community partner support for local job fairs and drop-in events. Their focus is to activate community partners to achieve a candidate funnel for their assigned risk markets. Regional Partnerships Managers own the development and execution of local workforce development and recruitment strategies in Amazon’s most constrained markets. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for this position are tied to increasing the hourly entry-level talent pipeline, removing obstacles faced by local candidates, reducing the need for paid advertising and recruiting space, and meeting Candidate Generation hiring goals.

This role requires the ability to keep composure in fast-moving situations, embrace ambiguity, quickly get up to speed on complex issues, anticipate community partner questions/reactions, and formulate thorough messaging strategies that position Amazon as the local employer of choice. The key skills and abilities for this role include consulting, facilitation, influencing, communication, coaching, analysis, risk evaluation, empathy, problem solving, and high judgment with the ability to use data to make decisions.

We roll up our sleeves, work hard, have fun and make history!

Key job responsibilities

  • Partners with Candidate Attraction leadership and internal stakeholders (marketing, Audience Channel owners, Field & Business Management team) to develop local marketing strategy based on market data and local insight to generate applications.
  • Responsible for delivering on KPIs to meet Candidate Attraction hiring goals including targeted Audiences (eg. Military, People with Disabilities, Referrals, Refugees, etc.) and risk geographies.
  • Enables hiring through local vendor partnerships.
  • Identifies and develops programs and initiatives aimed at eliminating local employment barriers.
  • Creates and executes marketing plans, based upon data to implement scalable hiring strategies for geographies.
  • Owns the establishment and maintenance of long-term relationships with centers-of-influence and select workforce organizations. Builds and fosters workforce development relationships that demonstrate return on investment.
  • Gains and maintains awareness of labor markets and their impact on Amazon’s near and long-term hourly staffing needs.
  • Develops internal partnerships with the ability to influence internal stakeholders, CG (Candidate Generation) Channel Managers, Marketing and Staffing Management Field teams; public policy teams (state and local); public relations teams; local operations and HR teams to ensure alignment.

A day in the life

  • Manages the analyses of weekly, monthly and quarterly reporting of Candidate Generation activity performance via Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for assigned geographies.
  • Identifies and schedules Drop-in events, hiring fairs, information sessions, etc. to drive hires.
  • Researches and executes opportunities and coordinates activity related to large scale community events such as conferences and job fairs that will drive hires.
  • Leads and drives projects of increasing scale and complexity, and manages programs through to completion.
  • Owns training, development, team culture and driving activities related to Candidate Generation with Field teams.
  • Must be able to travel as needed to conduct events in various locations within your designated assigned geographical area. Regional travel up to 50% of the time required.

About the team

This team facilitates community partner support for local job fairs and drop-in events. Their focus is to activate community partners to achieve a candidate funnel for their assigned risk markets.

We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better‑rounded professional.

title: Onboarding Manager - Publishers (Remote)
description:
About MonetizeMore

MonetizeMore is a global leader in ad tech, seen by 300M+ people monthly. For 16 years, we’ve achieved double-digit growth by blending proprietary AI technology with manual optimization techniques to empower publishers. We are a culture-centric, location-independent organization that values Integrity, Enterprising, Kaizen, and Collaboration.

MonetizeMore offers location and schedule freedom to every one of its team members. That means that you would have the lifestyle autonomy to choose to work from anywhere in the world, during the time of day you prefer. This new-age work lifestyle would enable you to engineer your ideal lifestyle. Say goodbye to endless commutes, stuffy business attire, and the arbitrary 9 to 5 work-day. Take your life back into your hands by joining the MonetizeMore team!

What You’ll Do

As part of our Publisher Centric Team , At M2, we focus and emphasize proactive Publisher Services. As the Onboarding Manager, your role is a critical "first impression" of our organization and our ability to support our publishing partners in reaching their goals.

You will spearhead the onboarding process for new publishers, ensuring they are equipped with the right tech, knowledge, and confidence to succeed. You are not just setting up accounts you are orchestrating a "White Glove" experience that reduces time-to-value and sets the stage for long-term retention. You also pay attention to improving our systems and processes along the way to continuously improve our service to publishers.

Responsibilities

  1. Project Management & Implementation
    • Lead the Lifecycle: Expertly manage the publisher journey from Sales endorsement to "Live" status. You are the project manager for the publisher’s first 30-90 days.
    • Technical Coordination: Collaborate with Account Executives and Solutions Engineers to troubleshoot setup concerns (Header Bidding, GAM, wrappers) and ensure optimal configuration.
    • Feature Activation: Ensure all applicable M2 Tech Features are activated at launch to maximize publisher revenue immediately (KPI: Uptake %).
  2. Client-Centric Communication & Education
    • Kick-off & Strategy: Conduct kick-off calls to understand the publisher's specific business goals and align our implementation plan to meet them.
    • Ambassadorship: Act as the primary champion for M2 tools and products. Provide comprehensive walkthroughs to ensure publishers are comfortable and proficient with our platform.
    • Responsive Support: Serve as the primary point of contact for all questions during installation, providing guidance that is both technical and empathetic.
  3. Performance Analysis & Handoff
    • Performance Reviews: Conduct thorough 7-day and 30-day post-live performance reviews. Use data to demonstrate value and identify early optimization wins.
    • Seamless Transition: Manage a structured handoff to the Ad Optimizer and Customer Success Manager, ensuring no momentum is lost after the initial 30-day period.

Day-today Activities

You are the external face of MonetizeMore for our newest partners. You thrive on variety and high-energy interaction—no two days (or publishers) are exactly alike.

  • External Engagement: You will constantly meet new partners, leading high-impact kickoff calls to align our tech with their specific business goals.
  • Project Command: You project manage the entire implementation lifecycle, coordinating between the publisher and our technical teams to ensure an optimal, revenue-ready setup and accelerated scale.
  • Performance Ownership: You don't just "set it and forget it." You conduct data-driven 7-day and 30-day etc. performance reviews to prove value immediately.
  • Seamless Handoff: Once the foundation is solid, you orchestrate a smooth transfer to the account management team ensuring the relationship momentum continues uninterrupted.

How this role fits into the organization

This is a cornerstone role that is pivotal to our company’s success.

  • Strategic Impact: Reporting to the Ad Ops Team Manager, you are the architect of the "First 30 Days." Since our publishers' growth is our growth, our long-term revenue goals effectively start on your desk.
  • The "Wow" Factor: You are responsible for delivering the "White Glove" experience. You set the trajectory for retention by uncovering publisher goals early and proving that MonetizeMore is a partner, not just a vendor.
  • Bridge Builder: You act as the vital link between Sales promises and long-term Operational success, ensuring that every new client enters our ecosystem with clarity, confidence, and a setup primed for revenue generation.

Who You Are

title: Assistant Professor
description:
Overview

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Assistant or Associate Professor – Mathematics (AI for Radiology & Endocrinology)

The Department of Mathematics in the College of Arts and Sciences at Howard University invites applications for a full-time, tenure-track Assistant or Associate Professor position. The department seeks candidates with research expertise and teaching interests in mathematics enhanced artificial intelligence (AI), with applications to radiology, endocrinology, and related biomedical domains. The anticipated start date is August 2026. This position is part of the Provost’s Artificial Intelligence Cluster Hire Initiative and is embedded within the interdisciplinary cluster “Advancing Health through Mathematics-Enhanced AI for Radiology and Endocrinology”, jointly led by the College of Arts and Sciences and the College of Medicine. The cluster aims to strengthen university-wide research capacity by recruiting faculty whose scholarship advances mathematical foundations, modeling, and computational methodologies that support AI-driven biomedical discovery, while fostering collaboration across disciplines.

SUPERVISORY AUTHORITY

The successful candidate is expected to demonstrate a strong commitment to excellence in teaching, mentoring, and service. The faculty member will contribute to the growth of the Department of Mathematics’ research and academic programs in data science, applied mathematics, and AI, and will actively participate in interdisciplinary initiatives across the university.

Nature And Scope

From a mathematics-centered perspective, this position emphasizes the development and application of mathematical theory, statistical modeling, and computational methods that underpin modern AI and machine learning approaches in biomedical sciences. The cluster seeks to advance quantitative frameworks for imaging, inference, prediction, and decision-making in complex biological and clinical systems. The successful candidate will contribute to an interdisciplinary academic environment through research, teaching, mentorship, and collaboration.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Conduct high-quality, externally visible research in applied mathematics, machine learning, and artificial intelligence, with relevance to biology and medicine.
  • Develop and sustain an externally funded research program, including collaborative interdisciplinary projects.
  • Teach undergraduate and graduate courses in mathematics, data science, machine learning, and artificial intelligence.
  • Supervise and mentor undergraduate and graduate students, postdoctoral scholars, and junior researchers.
  • Collaborate with faculty across mathematics, medicine, and related disciplines to advance AI-enabled quantitative methods for biomedical applications.

Core Competencies

The Department of Mathematics particularly encourages applicants with expertise in one or more of the following areas:

  • Mathematical Foundations of AI and Machine Learning: Optimization, statistical learning theory, inverse problems, uncertainty quantification, dynamical systems, or computational mathematics relevant to AI.
  • AI and Data-Driven Modeling in Biomedicine: Development of mathematical and computational methods for imaging, neuroscience, endocrinology, diabetes, or other data-intensive biomedical domains.
  • Interdisciplinary Research and Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to collaborate with clinicians, biologists, or engineers to develop mathematically grounded AI/ML approaches for complex biological and medical datasets.

Minimum Requirements

  • Ph.D. in Mathematics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a closely related field.
  • Strong research record in mathematics-driven AI or ML, with applications to biology or medicine, evidenced by peer-reviewed publications.
  • Demonstrated ability or clear potential to secure external research funding.
  • Evidence of excellence or strong potential in undergraduate and graduate teaching.
  • Commitment to interdisciplinary collaboration, student mentorship, and advancing diversity, equity, and inclusion in teaching and research.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

Compensation Range: $135,000 - $150,000

OYO is seeking a dynamic and results-driven individual to take on the role of Commercial Executive , focusing on driving business development and fostering strong relationships with our property partners. This position requires a strategic thinker with a passion for building and expanding our network of properties, maximizing revenue opportunities, and ensuring exceptional customer satisfaction.

This Commercial Executive role offers an exciting opportunity to drive business growth, expand OYO's presence in key markets, and contribute to the success of our organization. If you are a motivated and entrepreneurial individual with a passion for business development and hospitality, we invite you to join our team and help us build the most trusted brand in the world.

Brief Job Description

As a Commercial Executive , you will play a pivotal role in driving business growth by identifying and engaging with potential business partners to expand OYO's presence in key markets. You will be responsible for developing and executing strategies to attract new properties, negotiate agreements, and drive adoption of the OYO OS model. Additionally, you will work closely with property owners to understand their needs, provide ongoing support, and ensure a seamless onboarding process.

Job Overview

The Commercial Executive will be primarily focused on business development initiatives, including prospecting, lead generation, and partnership building. You will leverage your strong communication and negotiation skills to cultivate relationships with property owners, drive adoption of OYO's products and services, and maximize revenue opportunities. In addition to expanding our network of properties, you will also collaborate with internal teams to develop and implement strategies to optimize the performance of existing properties.

  • Meet with customers/clients face to face & or over the phone.
  • Developing proposals for clients.
  • Provide ongoing support to property owners, including assistance with onboarding, training, and troubleshooting.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to develop and implement strategies to optimize property performance and drive revenue growth.
  • Monitor market trends and competitor activity to identify opportunities for expansion and differentiation.
  • Coordinate pricing strategies with Revenue Managers
  • Ensure room availability (for selling) for the company.
  • Recovery of debt.
  • Churn prevention: Engage with partners to educate them around the solutions Oyo provides and reduce churn.
  • Partner Experience: Ensuring our partners are looked after is critical and so this role is responsible in supporting post onboarding to ensure brand standards, recon statements, commercial understanding (if any) and act as a support function for the partner.

Job Experience

2-3 years of relevant experience in business development, sales, or related fields, preferably in Real Estate and Hospitality industries.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Hospitality Management, or a related field.

Language

Fluent in English (both verbal and written).

Skills and qualifications

  • Drive and self-motivation.
  • Networking ability
  • Strong business development skills, with a proven track record of identifying and closing new business opportunities.
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders.
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to analyze market trends, identify opportunities, and develop actionable plans to drive growth.
  • Results-oriented mindset with a focus on achieving targets and delivering measurable results.
  • Highly organized with strong project management skills and the ability to prioritize and multitask effectively.

description:
O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 121 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 95.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.

Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.

Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de 13.000 colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

SOBRE A VAGA

A Escola Eleva é uma das escolas Inspired no Brasil. Aqui nós temos vocação para ensinar e paixão por aprender. Nosso time é movido por excelência, entusiasmo, respeito e responsabilidade. Somos adeptos da mentalidade de crescimento e estamos constantemente motivados a buscar o que há de melhor em educação, no Brasil e no mundo e em pensar as melhores maneiras de aplicar isso em nossas escolas e inspirar nossos alunos.

Nossa missão é formar uma nova geração de líderes capazes de fazer a diferença em suas vidas e contribuir para um mundo melhor. Para isso, contamos com um time de profissionais inquietos, com brilho nos olhos e movidos por entusiasmo. Pessoas que superam desafios diariamente, com otimismo e acreditando no legado que estamos construindo.

Procuramos um(a) Professor(a) de Dança para o infantil. Deve ser uma pessoa com paixão por educação e pelo universo dinâmico da escola, que tenha experiência em escola regular ou bilíngue com planejamento e execução de aulas.

RESPONSABILIDADES

O que você fará:

  • Adquirir conhecimento sobre os programas curriculares utilizados nas séries em que leciona;
  • Trabalhar colaborativamente com outros professores e lideranças da matéria e do segmento, buscando alinhamento e consistência;
  • Planejar as aulas e produzir materiais pedagógicos, levando em conta as individualidades dos alunos;
  • Ministrar aulas de Dança alinhadas com a BNCC e o Material Didático selecionado pela escola (físico ou digital);
  • Utilizar práticas variadas de ensino/aprendizagem, incluindo metodologias ativas, ensino responsivo, avaliação para o aprendizado (Assessment for Learning) e métodos investigativos;
  • Utilizar de forma consistente tecnologias para enriquecer e melhorar o aprendizado;
  • Supervisionar alunos em espaços escolares;
  • Substituir professores no mesmo segmento quando solicitado;
  • Mediar relacionamento entre crianças, famílias e escola;
  • Preparar avaliações e comunicar os resultados;
  • Tabular e analisar dados pedagógicos com o intuito de ajustar ensino e melhorar o aprendizado;
  • Formatar e alimentar com dados nossa plataforma de acompanhamento de avaliações (iSams) em preparação para relatórios para famílias;
  • Participar de reuniões pedagógicas (incluindo COC) e eventos realizados na escola;
  • Garantir a segurança física e emocional dos alunos, e zelar pelo seu crescimento sócio-emocional (safeguarding).

Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.

REQUISITOS

O que você precisa ter:

  • Diploma de Licenciatura em Dança;
  • Experiência com infantil;
  • Inglês fluente para ministrar as aulas nesse idioma.

Nossos professores devem ser capazes de/devem ter:

  • Capacidade de trabalhar colaborativamente, em equipe;
  • Paixão pela profissão;
  • Adaptar seu estilo de ensino incorporando feedbacks;
  • Estar sempre em busca de melhorias;
  • Atitude positiva frente a mudanças;
  • Compreensão profunda da matéria lecionada;
  • Estabelecer expectativas claras e esticar metas;
  • Excelente planejamento de aulas e domínio de sala;
  • Habilidade de julgar a efetividade do aprendizado;
  • Comprometimento com o desenvolvimento dos alunos, avaliando os resultados e fornecendo feedback para melhorar seu desempenho;
  • Preocupação e atenção genuína pelos níveis mais altos de bem-estar dos alunos.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais;
  • Espírito colaborativo - desejo de trabalhar como parte de um time;
  • Pós-graduação em andamento ou concluída.

DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação.

Careers & University Coordinator (Whole School)

Key responsibilities

Strategic leadership and curriculum development

  • Curriculum Development: Develop and implement a progressive careers curriculum, integrating it with the school's IB programs and collaborating with Pastoral Leads and IB Coordinators to embed careers and life skills into the pastoral framework.
  • Training and Management: Lead the training and development of Year 12 and 13 Tutors and Heads of Year to provide consistent, high-quality university application support, ideally maintaining the same staff with each cohort for continuity.
  • Technology Integration: Manage and utilize an online central hub for all careers resources, communications, and student progress tracking.
  • Technology Integration: Ensure careers counselors have the tools and assessments needed to evaluate students’ strengths and interests, guiding them toward suitable academic and career pathways.

Higher education guidance and admissions

  • International admissions expertise : Provide expert guidance on domestic and international university applications, with strong knowledge of UCAS (UK), the Common Application (US), European systems, and the Brazilian Vestibular process, while maintaining close relationships with university admissions departments.

  • Application management: Oversee all aspects of the application process, including setting and enforcing deadlines for student and teacher components, and ensuring transcript quality and accuracy.

Events, outreach, and student experience

  • Parent presentations: Design and deliver parent presentations that clearly communicate admissions processes, funding options, and career pathways.
  • Alumni and local experts network: Support the development and maintenance of a strong alumni and local expert network to provide mentoring, career insights, and resources for current students.
  • School communication: Ensure timely and effective communication regarding all career events, deadlines, and news across the whole school.
  • International Cultural Development: Support the school leadership team in promoting global citizenship, international mindedness, and aspirations for international study.

Requirements

  • Fluency in English (written and spoken) is essential to effectively guide students and communicate with both local and international universities and parents.
  • Proven teaching experience at the secondary level, preferably within the IB framework.
  • Bachelor's degree in Education, Psychology, International Relations, HR or related fields, besides proven experience and demonstrable knowledge of the UCAS, US, European, and Brazilian university admissions processes.
  • Proven ability to build a comprehensive strategic vision in partnership with leadership colleagues to create buy-in from stakeholders and hold direct reports accountable for the day‑to‑day delivery of this vision.
  • Exceptional ability to build rapport with students, parents, university representatives, and colleagues. Strong oral and written communication skills.
